column6: 中新网北京2月11日电(门睿)近日发布的《2022中国海归就业调查报告》(下称“报告”)显示，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高，我国企业对海外人才的需求亦呈上扬态势。
column7: Chinanews.com, Beijing, February 11 (Men Rui) recently released the "2022 Chinese Returnees Employment Survey Report" (hereinafter referred to as the "Report"), which shows that the number of international students in 2022 will increase by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job hunting will hit a new high, Chinese enterprises' demand for overseas talents is also on the rise.

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report points out that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking jobs in China has increased significantly, and the number of fresh international students returning to China for job hunting has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the number of international students graduating in 2022 will increase by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job hunting will hit a new high.

column6: 从回国求职留学生的留学国家分布来看，英国占比最高，为41.4%，其次是澳大利亚(20.3%)和美国(9%)，排名与2021年一致。
column7: From the perspective of the distribution of overseas students returning to China for job hunting, the United Kingdom has the highest proportion, 41.4%, followed by Australia (20.3%) and the United States (9%), ranking the same as in 2021.

column6: 从同比增速来看，2022年来自马来西亚、日本、新加坡的应届留学生人数同比大幅上升，增速分别为66.1%、50.9%和37.7%。
column7: Judging from the year-on-year growth rate, the number of fresh international students from Malaysia, Japan, and Singapore will increase significantly year-on-year in 2022, with growth rates of 66.1%, 50.9%, and 37.7% respectively.

column6: 来自加拿大、德国、美国、澳大利亚的应届留学生人数同比下降。
column7: The number of fresh international students from Canada, Germany, the United States, and Australia decreased year-on-year.

column7: It is proposed that a high-speed, large-capacity and low-latency super broadband network will be built before the end of 2023, to achieve the goal of “dual gigabit, all-optical network, 1 millisecond, and everything connected” network construction, and to create the first in China and the world's leading ultra-fast pioneer city.

column6: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
column7: The "Plan" proposes to accelerate the upgrading of gigabit optical networks.

column6: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
column7: By the end of 2023, the proportion of 10G PON ports will reach 100%, and the number of all-optical industrial parks (industrial parks) will exceed 100.

column6: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
column7: The "Plan" requires that the energy efficiency of 5G networks be comprehensively improved.

column6: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
column7: <v>Research and formulate</v> Shenzhen 5G network service quality specifications and standards, carry out 5G network testing and evaluation, and improve 5G network service quality.

column6: 费用省一半甚至更多？
column7: Save half or even more on costs?

column6: 河南省规范整合口腔种植医疗服务价格-中新网
column7: Henan Province standardizes and integrates the price of oral implant medical services - China News <v>Network</v>.

column6: 河南省规范整合口腔种植医疗服务价格-中新网
column7: Henan Province standardizes and integrates the price of oral implant medical services - China News Network<v>.</v>

column6: 央视网消息：种植牙是很多缺牙患者的理想选择，但一直以来，动辄上万元一颗的价格让很多患者望而却步。
column7: According to CCTV News: Dental implants are the ideal choice for many patients with missing teeth, but the cost, often tens of thousands per tooth, has <v>deterred</v> many.

column6: 今年以来，随着种植牙集采的加速落地，各地也将种植牙降价提上日程。
column7: Since the beginning of this year, with the accelerated implementation of centralized procurement of dental implants, various places have also put the price reduction of dental implants on the agenda.

column6: 从2月10日起，河南省单颗常规种植牙医疗服务价格全流程调控目标为4300元，单颗常规种植全流程费用不高于调控目标的97%。
column7: Starting from February <v>10</v>, the full-process price control target for conventional dental implant medical services in Henan Province is 4300 yuan, and the full-process cost of a single conventional implant should not exceed 97% of the control target.

column6: 种植牙齿指的是一种以植入骨组织内的下部结构为基础来支持、固位上部牙修复体的缺牙修复方式。
column7: Dental implantation refers to a method of tooth restoration that uses an underlying structure implanted in the bone tissue to support and stabilize the upper dental prosthesis.

column6: 记者从郑州大学第一附属医院了解到，以单颗常规种植为例，从种植到最后修复，价格大概要一万六七千元左右。
column7: Reporters learned from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University that, taking a single conventional implant as an example, the price from implantation to final restoration is about 16,000 to 17,000 yuan.

column6: 患者何莹：新政策之后，大夫跟我说，像我这种情况差不多就是8000多元、不到1万元，基本上能省一半。
column7: Patient He Ying: After the new policy, the doctor told me that in my case, it would be around 8,000 yuan, less than 10,000 yuan, basically saving half.

column6: 在现行项目基础上，河南省还整合确定了“种植体植入费(单颗)”等15个口腔种植类医疗服务价格项目，并统一制定省管公立医疗机构价格和医保支付类别，取消或调整了牙种植体植入术等20个医疗服务价格项目。
column7: Based on the current project, Henan Province has also integrated and determined 15 <v>oral implantation</v> medical service price items such as "implantation fee (per piece)", and uniformly formulated the price and medical insurance payment category of provincial public medical institutions, cancelling or adjusting 20 medical service price items such as dental implant surgery.

column6: 上世纪80年代，郑永刚担任国营棉纺厂的厂长，随着调任，1989年郑永刚成为杉杉股份的前身宁波云港服装总厂的厂长。
column7: In the 1980s, Zheng Yonggang served as the director of a state-owned cotton spinning factory, and with his transfer, he became the director of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the <v>predecessor</v> of Shanshan Shares, in 1989.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th China Business Leaders Annual Meeting and the 22nd China Future Stars Annual Meeting, Zheng Yonggang stated in his speech that in the Chinese suit market of the 1990s, the market share of the Shanshan brand once reached as high as 37%.

column6: 1996年杉杉股份（600884.SH）上市，成为中国服装业第一家上市公司。
column7: In 1996, Shanshan Shares (600884.SH) went public, becoming the first listed company in China's clothing industry.

column6: 就在服装业务如日中天时，杉杉集团却开始转型，因为郑永刚意识到， “ 一旦市场放开，中国品牌自然会形成一个梯队式品牌市场，杉杉西服想一直独领风骚，长期成为国人的国服的可能性不大” 。
column7: Just as the clothing business was booming, the Shanshan Group began to transform, because Zheng Yonggang realized that "once the market is opened up, Chinese brands will naturally form a tiered brand market, and the possibility of Shanshan suits always leading the trend and becoming the national dress of the Chinese people in the long term is not great."

column7: EU summit <v>bickering over</v> refugee policy, EU officials: bottlenecks at every step of the reception process

column6: 【环球时报驻比利时特派记者牛瑞飞】据法新社2月10日报道，在当天最新的一次欧盟峰会上，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，欧盟领导人同意就非法移民问题出台更严格的政策，以此更易于驱逐非法移民。
column7: At the latest EU summit on the day, European Commission President von der Leyen said EU leaders had agreed to a stricter policy on illegal immigration to make it easier to deport illegal migrants.

column6: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
column7: The move is reportedly a response to growing concerns about illegal immigration in Europe, where the core problem is the small number of illegal migrants who can ultimately be repatriated.

column6: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
column7: According to the summit document, EU leaders called on the Commission to “immediately mobilise substantial EU funds” to strengthen the external borders, including by means of infrastructure and surveillance.

column6: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
column7: However, the EU and member states have been arguing over issues such as the payment of fencing costs.

column6: 冯德莱恩一再表示，欧盟资金不会支付相关费用。
column7: Von der Leyen has repeatedly said that EU funds will not cover the costs.

column6: 但一些成员国的外交官员称，如果欧盟能分担外部边界沿线安装摄像头、瞭望塔和其他基础设施的部分，这将给各国腾出国家预算从而加快建设进程。
column7: But diplomats from some member states say that if the EU were to share the cost of installing cameras, watchtowers and other infrastructure along its external borders, it would free up national budgets to speed up the construction process.

column6: 欧洲Euractiv网站称，欧盟官员承认，难民接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈，有限的接收能力和成员国不堪重负的移民当局无法阻止难民在欧盟各国提交“无数”庇护申请，欧盟的难民接收系统处于近乎“永久性的危机”中。
column7: EU officials have acknowledged bottlenecks at every step of the process, limited reception capacity and overburdened immigration authorities in member states <v>to prevent refugees</v> from submitting “numerous” asylum applications in EU countries, and the EU's refugee reception system is in a near-permanent crisis.

column6: 欧盟峰会为难民政策争吵不休，欧盟官员：接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈
column7: EU summit <v>wrangles over</v> refugee policy, EU official: Bottlenecks at every step of reception process

column6: 【环球时报驻比利时特派记者牛瑞飞】据法新社2月10日报道，在当天最新的一次欧盟峰会上，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，欧盟领导人同意就非法移民问题出台更严格的政策，以此更易于驱逐非法移民。
column7: [Global Times Special Correspondent in Belgium Niu Ruifei] According to Agence France-Presse reported on February <v>10</v>, at the latest EU summit on the same day, European Commission President von der Leyen said that EU leaders agreed to introduce stricter policies on illegal immigration as a way to make it easier to deport illegal immigrants.

column6: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
column7: The EU's move is reportedly a response to growing concerns about illegal immigration in Europe, which now centers on the small number of illegal immigrants who can eventually be sent back.

column6: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
column7: According to the summit document, EU leaders called on the Commission to "immediately mobilise significant EU funding" to strengthen external borders with infrastructure and surveillance, among other things.

column6: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
column7: However, the EU is at loggerheads with member states over issues such as payment for the fence.

column6: 冯德莱恩一再表示，欧盟资金不会支付相关费用。
column7: Von der Leyen has repeatedly said EU funds will not cover the costs.

column6: 但一些成员国的外交官员称，如果欧盟能分担外部边界沿线安装摄像头、瞭望塔和其他基础设施的部分，这将给各国腾出国家预算从而加快建设进程。
column7: But diplomats from some member states say that if the EU could share the cost of installing cameras, watchtowers and other infrastructure along its external borders, it would free up national budgets to speed up the construction process.

column6: 欧洲Euractiv网站称，欧盟官员承认，难民接收过程每一步都存在瓶颈，有限的接收能力和成员国不堪重负的移民当局无法阻止难民在欧盟各国提交“无数”庇护申请，欧盟的难民接收系统处于近乎“永久性的危机”中。
column7: According to Euractiv, EU officials have admitted that there are bottlenecks at every step of the refugee reception process, that limited reception capacity and overstretched migration authorities in member states are unable to prevent refugees from submitting "numerous" asylum applications in EU countries, and that the EU's refugee reception system is in a near-permanent crisis.

column6: 据欧盟委员会估计，欧盟的申根国家去年收到超92万份庇护申请，比前一年增加近半。
column7: The European Commission estimates that the EU's Schengen countries received more than 920,000 asylum applications last year, nearly half more than the previous year.‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: On February 11, according to the <v>"</v>Shenzhen Industrial Information" WeChat public account, the Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the "Shenzhen City Pioneer City Construction Action Plan".

column6: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。
column7: It proposed that by the end of 2023, a super broadband network with high speed, large capacity, and low latency would be built to achieve the network construction goals of "double gigabit, all-optical network, 1 millisecond, and Internet of Everything", creating the country's first and world-leading ultra-fast pioneer city.

column6: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
column7: The plan proposes to accelerate the upgrade of the gigabit optical network.

column6: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
column7: By the end of 2023, the proportion of 10G PON ports will reach 100%, and the number of all-optical industrial parks will exceed 100.

column6: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
column7: The "Plan" requires a comprehensive improvement in the energy efficiency of 5G networks.

column6: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
column7: Research and develop the quality standard specifications for 5G network services in Shenzhen, carry out 5G network testing and evaluation, and improve the quality of 5G network services.

column6: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
column7: Support is given to basic telecommunications companies to increase their efforts in optimizing 5G networks in key areas and locations. An additional 10,000 5G base stations were added throughout the year, with the city's average download speed reaching 500Mbps and upload speed reaching 100Mbps. In key areas, download speeds reached 1000Mbps and upload speeds reached 200Mbps, significantly improving network speed and user experience.

column6: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
column7: The <v>"Plan"</v> requires that the energy efficiency of 5G networks be comprehensively improved.

column7: Research and formulate Shenzhen 5G network service quality norms and standards, carry out 5G network test and evaluation, and improve 5G network service quality.

column7: Support basic telecommunications companies to increase the optimization of 5G networks in key areas and places, add 10,000 5G base stations throughout the year, the city's average download rate reaches 500Mbps, and the uplink rate reaches 100Mbps, and the download rate in key areas reaches 1000Mbps, and the uplink rate reaches 200Mbps. column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th Annual Meeting of Chinese Business Leaders and the 22nd Annual Meeting of Future Stars of Chinese Enterprises, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the Chinese suit market in the 90s of last century, the market share of the Shanshan brand was as high as 37%.

column6: 1996年杉杉股份（600884.SH）上市，成为中国服装业第一家上市公司。

column6: 上世纪80年代，郑永刚担任国营棉纺厂的厂长，随着调任，1989年郑永刚成为杉杉股份的前身宁波云港服装总厂的厂长。
column7: In the 80s of the last century, Zheng Yonggang was the factory manager of a state-owned cotton spinning factory. Following his transfer, Zheng Yonggang became the factory manager of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the predecessor of Shanshan Co., Ltd. in 1989.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th Annual Conference of Chinese Business Leaders and the 22nd Annual Conference of Chinese Business Future Stars, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the Chinese suit market in the 90s of the last century, the market share of the Shanshan brand was as high as 37 percent.

column6: 1996年杉杉股份（600884.SH）上市，成为中国服装业第一家上市公司。
column7: In 1996, Shanshan Co., Ltd. (600884.SH) went public, becoming the first listed company in the Chinese garment industry.

column6: 就在服装业务如日中天时，杉杉集团却开始转型，因为郑永刚意识到， “ 一旦市场放开，中国品牌自然会形成一个梯队式品牌市场，杉杉西服想一直独领风骚，长期成为国人的国服的可能性不大” 。
column7: Just when the clothing business was in full swing, the Shanshan Group began to transform because Zheng Yonggang realized, “Once the market is liberalized, Chinese brands will naturally form an echelon brand market. <v>Shanshan Western clothing has always dominated the style</v>, and it is unlikely that it will become the national uniform of the Chinese people for a long time.”

column7: Chinanews.com<v>,</v> Beijing, February 11th (Men Rui) recently released the "2022 Chinese Returnees Employment Survey Report" (hereinafter referred to as the "Report"), which shows that the number of international students in 2022 will increase by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job hunting will hit a new high , Chinese enterprises' demand for overseas talents is also on the rise.

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report pointed out that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking jobs in China has increased significantly, and the number of fresh graduates returning to China to seek jobs has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the number of international students graduating in 2022 will increase by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job hunting will hit a new high.

column6: 从回国求职留学生的留学国家分布来看，英国占比最高，为41.4%，其次是澳大利亚(20.3%)和美国(9%)，排名与2021年一致。
column7: From the perspective of the distribution of overseas students returning to China for job hunting, the United Kingdom has the highest proportion, 41.4%, followed by Australia (20.3%) and the United States (9%), ranking the same as in 2021.

column6: 从同比增速来看，2022年来自马来西亚、日本、新加坡的应届留学生人数同比大幅上升，增速分别为66.1%、50.9%和37.7%。
column7: Judging from the year-on-year growth rate, the number of fresh international students from Malaysia, Japan, and Singapore will increase significantly year-on-year in 2022, with growth rates of 66.1%, 50.9%, and 37.7% respectively.

column6: 来自加拿大、德国、美国、澳大利亚的应届留学生人数同比下降。
column7: The number of fresh international students from Canada, Germany, the United States, and Australia decreased year-on-year.

column7: The report points out that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking jobs in China has significantly increased, and the number of returning graduates seeking jobs has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。

column6: 从回国求职留学生的留学国家分布来看，英国占比最高，为41.4%，其次是澳大利亚(20.3%)和美国(9%)，排名与2021年一致。
column7: Looking at the distribution of the countries where returning students seeking jobs studied, the UK has the highest proportion, accounting for 41.4%, followed by Australia (20.3%) and the United States (9%), ranking the same as in 2021.

column6: 从同比增速来看，2022年来自马来西亚、日本、新加坡的应届留学生人数同比大幅上升，增速分别为66.1%、50.9%和37.7%。
column7: In terms of year-on-year growth rate, the number of 2022 <v>graduates studying abroad from Malaysia, Japan, and Singapore</v> has increased significantly, with growth rates of 66.1%, 50.9%, and 37.7% respectively.

column6: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。
column7: Among them, it is proposed that by the end of 2023, a high-speed, large-capacity, and low-latency ultra-broadband network will be built to achieve the goal of "dual gigabit, all-optical network, 1 millisecond, and Internet of Everything" network construction, creating the first domestic and world-leading ultra-fast pioneer city.

column7: The Plan proposes to accelerate the upgrade of gigabit optical networks.

column7: The report highlights that since 2020, there has been a significant increase in the number of repatriated students seeking to work in China and the number of students returning to the country seeking employment.

column6: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
column7: The "Plan" proposes to accelerate the upgrade of gigabit optical networks.

column6: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
column7: By the end of 2023, the proportion of 10G PON ports will reach 100%, and the number of all-optical industrial parks (industrial parks) will exceed 100.

column6: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
column7: The "Plan" requires that the energy efficiency of 5G networks be comprehensively improved.

column6: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
column7: Research and formulate Shenzhen 5G network service quality norms and standards, carry out 5G network test and evaluation, and improve 5G network service quality.

column6: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
column7: Support basic telecommunications enterprises to increase the optimization of 5G networks in key areas and places, add 10,000 5G base stations throughout the year, the city's average download rate reaches 500Mbps, and the uplink rate reaches 100Mbps, and the download rate in key areas reaches 1000Mbps, and the uplink rate reaches 200Mbps. The network speed and user experience have been greatly improved.

column6: 打造城市级高品质无线局域网。
column7: Create a city-level high-quality wireless LAN.

column6: 制定公共场所无线局域网(WLAN)服务规范，推动全市各区人员密集和信息消费需求集中区域WLAN升级，提供千兆接入能力。
column7: Formulate wireless local area network (WLAN) service specifications in public places, promote WLAN upgrades in areas with dense population and concentrated information consumption demand in all districts of the city, and provide gigabit access capabilities.‏‏‏‏

column7: Economic Observer Network reporter Zheng Yu Xin, February 11, the WeChat public account certified by Shanshan Holdings Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Shanshan Holdings") announced that Zheng Yonggang, the founder of Shanshan Enterprises and the chairman of the board of directors of Shanshan Holdings, died of a sudden heart disease on February <v>10</v>, 2023, at the age of 65.

column6: 上世纪80年代，郑永刚担任国营棉纺厂的厂长，随着调任，1989年郑永刚成为杉杉股份的前身宁波云港服装总厂的厂长。
column7: In the 1980s, Zheng Yonggang served as the director of a state-owned cotton spinning factory. With his transfer, in 1989, Zheng Yonggang became the director of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the predecessor of Shanshan Shares.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th China Enterprise Leaders Annual Meeting and the 22nd China Future Stars Annual Meeting, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the Chinese suit market in the 1990s, the market share of Shanshan brand <v>once reached</v> 37%.

column6: 1996年杉杉股份（600884.SH）上市，成为中国服装业第一家上市公司。
column7: In 1996, Shanshan Shares (600884.SH) was listed, becoming the first listed company in China's clothing industry.

column6: 就在服装业务如日中天时，杉杉集团却开始转型，因为郑永刚意识到， “ 一旦市场放开，中国品牌自然会形成一个梯队式品牌市场，杉杉西服想一直独领风骚，长期成为国人的国服的可能性不大” 。
column7: Just when the clothing business was booming, Shanshan Group began to transform, because Zheng Yonggang realized that "once the market is opened, Chinese brands will naturally form a tiered brand market, and it is not likely that Shanshan suits will always <v>lead the trend</v> and become the national dress of the Chinese people in the long term".

column6: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。
column7: It proposes that by the end of 2023, a super broadband network with high speed, large capacity, and low latency will be built, achieving the goal of "double gigabit, all-optical network, 1 millisecond, Internet of Everything" network construction, and building the fastest pioneer city in China and <v>leading the world</v>.

column6: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
column7: The <v>"Plan"</v> proposes to accelerate the upgrade of the gigabit optical network.

column6: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
column7: By the end of 2023, the proportion of 10G PON ports will reach 100%, and the number of all-optical industrial parks (industrial parks) will exceed 100.

column6: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
column7: The <v>"Plan"</v> requires a comprehensive improvement in the energy efficiency of 5G networks.

column6: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
column7: <v>Research and formulate</v> Shenzhen 5G network service quality standards, carry out 5G network testing and evaluation, and improve the quality of 5G network services.

column6: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
column7: Support basic telecommunications companies to increase the optimization of 5G networks in key areas and places, add 10,000 5G base stations throughout the year, the city's average download speed reaches 500Mbps, the upload speed reaches 100Mbps, the download speed in key areas reaches 1000Mbps, the upload speed reaches 200Mbps, the network speed and user experience are greatly improved.

column7: China News Service, February 11 /PRNewswire-USNewswire/ <v>--</v> According to the "Shenzhen Industry and Information Technology" WeChat public number on the 10th, the Shenzhen Municipal Bureau of Industry and Information Technology recently issued the "Shenzhen Extreme Pioneer City Construction Action Plan".

column6: 其中提出，2023年底前，建成高速率、大容量、低时延的超级宽带网络，实现“双千兆、全光网、1毫秒、万物联”网络建设目标，打造国内第一、世界领先的极速先锋城市。
column7: It is proposed that by the end of 2023, a high-speed, high-capacity, low-latency super-broadband network will be built to achieve the goal of "dual gigabit, all-optical network, 1 millisecond, <v>everything connected</v>" network construction, to create the first domestic and world-leading high-speed pioneer city.

column6: 《计划》提出，加快升级千兆光网。
column7: The Plan proposes to accelerate the upgrading of gigabit optical networks.

column6: 2023年底前，10G PON端口占比达到100%，全光工业园区(产业园区)数量超过100家。
column7: By the end of 2023, the proportion of 10G PON ports will reach 100%, and the number of all-optical industrial parks (industrial parks) will exceed 100.

column6: 《计划》要求，全面提升5G网络能效。
column7: The Plan calls for an overall improvement in the energy efficiency of 5G networks.

column6: 研究制定深圳5G网络服务质量规范标准，开展5G网络测试评估，提升5G网络服务质量。
column7: Study and formulate Shenzhen 5G network service quality standards, carry out 5G network testing and evaluation, improve 5G network service quality.

column6: 支持基础电信企业加大对重点区域、场所5G网络的优化力度，全年新增5G基站10000个，全市平均下载速率达到500Mbps、上行速率达到100Mbps，重点区域下载速率达到1000Mbps、上行速率达到200Mbps，网络速率和用户体验感大幅提升。
column7: <v>We</v> support basic telecommunications enterprises to increase the optimization of 5G networks in key areas and places, adding 10,000 new 5G base stations throughout the year, with an average download rate of 500Mbps and an upstream rate of 100Mbps in the city, and a download rate of 1000Mbps and an upstream rate of 200Mbps in key areas.

column6: 据华尔街日报今天报道称，气球事件后，美国准备进一步收紧对华技术出口。
column7: According to a report in the Wall Street Journal today, the US is preparing to further tighten technology exports to China following the balloon incident.

column6: 现任和前任安全官员表示，上述气球事件突显了中国构成的国家安全威胁，并将为加强美国技术保护争取更多政治支持。
column7: Current and former security officials have said that the aforementioned balloon incident highlights the national security threat posed by China, and will be used to garner more political support for strengthening <v>US</v> technology protection.

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report points out that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking employment in China has increased significantly, and the number of fresh international students returning to China to seek employment has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the scale of <v>fresh international students</v> in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China to seek employment reached a new high.

column6: 上世纪80年代，郑永刚担任国营棉纺厂的厂长，随着调任，1989年郑永刚成为杉杉股份的前身宁波云港服装总厂的厂长。
column7: In the 1980s, Zheng Yonggang served as the director of a state-owned cotton mill, and in 1989, Zheng Yonggang became the director of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the predecessor of Shanshan.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th Annual Conference of Chinese Enterprise Leaders and the 22nd Annual Conference of Future Stars of Chinese Enterprises, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the 1990s, the market share of Shanshan brand in China's suit market was as high as 37%.

column6: 1996年杉杉股份（600884.SH）上市，成为中国服装业第一家上市公司。
column7: In 1996, Shanshan shares (600884.SH) went public, becoming the first listed company in China's garment industry.

column6: 就在服装业务如日中天时，杉杉集团却开始转型，因为郑永刚意识到， “ 一旦市场放开，中国品牌自然会形成一个梯队式品牌市场，杉杉西服想一直独领风骚，长期成为国人的国服的可能性不大” 。
column7: When the clothing business was in the ascendant, Shanshan Group began to transform, because Zheng Yonggang realized that " once the market is liberalized, Chinese brands will naturally form an echelon brand market, <v>Shanshan suits want to have been leading the way</v>, the long-term possibility of becoming the national clothing of the Chinese people is unlikely. "

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: According to the report, since 2020, the number of returnees seeking jobs in China has increased significantly, and the number of fresh international students returning home to seek jobs has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the number of incoming international students in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of returning international students seeking jobs reached a new high.

column6: 从回国求职留学生的留学国家分布来看，英国占比最高，为41.4%，其次是澳大利亚(20.3%)和美国(9%)，排名与2021年一致。
column7: In terms of the distribution of countries of study for returning international students seeking employment, the United Kingdom accounted for the highest share of 41.4%, followed by Australia (20.3%) and the United States (9%), ranking the same as in 2021.

column6: 从同比增速来看，2022年来自马来西亚、日本、新加坡的应届留学生人数同比大幅上升，增速分别为66.1%、50.9%和37.7%。
column7: In terms of year-on-year growth, the number of new international students from Malaysia, Japan<v> and</v> Singapore increased significantly year-on-year in 2022, with growth rates of 66.1%, 50.9% and 37.7% respectively.

column7: Henan Province standardizes and integrates the price of oral implant medical services - China News <v>Network</v>

column6: 央视网消息：种植牙是很多缺牙患者的理想选择，但一直以来，动辄上万元一颗的价格让很多患者望而却步。
column7: CCTV News: Dental implants are the ideal choice for many patients with missing teeth, but the <v>price of tens of thousands per tooth</v> has always deterred many patients.

column6: 今年以来，随着种植牙集采的加速落地，各地也将种植牙降价提上日程。
column7: Since this year, with the accelerated implementation of centralized procurement of dental implants, various places have also put the price reduction of dental implants on the agenda.

column6: 从2月10日起，河南省单颗常规种植牙医疗服务价格全流程调控目标为4300元，单颗常规种植全流程费用不高于调控目标的97%。
column7: Starting from February <v>10</v>, the full-process price control target for a single conventional dental implant medical service in Henan Province is 4300 yuan, and the full-process cost of a single conventional implant is not higher than 97% of the price control target.

column6: 种植牙齿指的是一种以植入骨组织内的下部结构为基础来支持、固位上部牙修复体的缺牙修复方式。
column7: Dental implants refer to a method of repairing missing teeth based on the lower structure implanted in the bone tissue to support and fix the upper dental prosthesis.

column6: 记者从郑州大学第一附属医院了解到，以单颗常规种植为例，从种植到最后修复，价格大概要一万六七千元左右。
column7: Reporters learned from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University that, taking a single conventional implant as an example, the price from implantation to final repair is about 16,000 to 17,000 yuan.

column6: 患者何莹：新政策之后，大夫跟我说，像我这种情况差不多就是8000多元、不到1万元，基本上能省一半。
column7: Patient He Ying: After the new policy, the doctor told me that in my case, <v>it would be about 8,000 yuan, less than 10,000 yuan,</v> basically saving half.

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report pointed out that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking employment in China has increased significantly, and the number of recent international students returning home seeking employment has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the number of incoming international students in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of returning international students seeking employment is a record high.

column6: 从回国求职留学生的留学国家分布来看，英国占比最高，为41.4%，其次是澳大利亚(20.3%)和美国(9%)，排名与2021年一致。
column7: In terms of the country distribution of returning students looking for work, the UK accounted for the highest proportion at 41.4%, followed by Australia (20.3%) and the United States (9%), ranking in line with 2021.

column6: 从同比增速来看，2022年来自马来西亚、日本、新加坡的应届留学生人数同比大幅上升，增速分别为66.1%、50.9%和37.7%。

column6: Google新推出的人工智能聊天机器人Bard出师不利，在宣传短片中“答错问题”，导致Google母公司Alphabet股价周三一度急挫8.9%，跌破100美元大关，市值蒸发1100亿美元（约4765亿令吉），截至周五闭市报94.57美元。
column7: Google's new chatbot Bard, <v>badly misinterpreted</v> in a promotional video and given wrong answers, caused the stock price of Alphabet, Google's parent company, to plummet 8.9% on Wednesday, falling below the $100 mark, evaporating to $110 billion (RM4,765 million), up from $94.57 (RM8,640 million) as of Friday's close.

column6: 新华社北京2月10日电中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平2月9日给第19批援助中非共和国的中国医疗队队员回信，向他们以及广大援外医疗队员致以问候并提出殷切期望。

column6: 孙先生表示，置业顾问表示这其实就是一份“保价协议”，目的是让买家放心出手，不用担心开发企业降价促销，“现在就怕买完了它就降价了，去售楼处闹吧没时间，不闹的话也确实窝心”。
column7: Mr. Sun stated that the property consultant said this was actually a "price protection agreement," designed to reassure buyers and prevent them from worrying about the developer lowering prices for promotions. "The fear now is that the price will drop after purchase. There's no time to make a fuss at the sales office, and it's indeed frustrating if you don't complain," he said.

column6: 还有不少买房人则认为，“保价协议”虽然是在给购房者吃“定心丸”，不过条件却不低。
column7: Many homebuyers believe that while "price <v>protection</v> agreements" are meant to reassure purchasers, the conditions are not low.

column6: 打算在江北买一套刚需房的郑女士说，保价的房源首先是要同一户型，还得在同一楼栋、同一个单元，买家可以比价的房源寥寥，因此“门槛”还是蛮高的。
column7: Ms. Zheng, who plans to buy a house in Jiangbei, said that the houses with a guaranteed price must first be of the same type, and also in the same building and unit. There are very few houses for buyers to compare prices, so the "threshold" is still quite high.

column6: 也有购房者认为，由于信息不对称，销售时不排除给出额外的让利，买家“维权”的难度不小。
column7: Some homebuyers believe that due to information asymmetry, it is not ruled out that extra concessions may be given during sales, and it is not easy for buyers to "defend their rights".‏‏

column6: 专家分析认为，台湾经济开年表现欠佳，增长压力不小。
column7: According to expert analysis, Taiwan's economy performed poorly at the beginning of the year, and the growth pressure is not small.

column6: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
column7: According to the financial affairs department of the Taiwan authorities, Taiwan's exports in January this year were 31.51 billion US dollars, an annual decrease of 21.2%, and it was the fifth consecutive month of negative growth.

column6: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
column7: Compared with the same period last year, the export value of 11 major export categories all declined.

column6: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
column7: <v>Plastic rubber</v> and its products, optical equipment fell the most, with an annual decrease of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

column6: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
column7: Exports of electronic components and components fell by 20.1% year-on-year, the largest drop in 11 years.

column6: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
column7: Among them, integrated circuits decreased by 18.3% year-on-year, the largest decline in 14 years.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
column7: <v>Cai Meina</v>, head of the statistics department of the department, said that this shows that the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry has spread, and the electronics industry has entered a correction period.

column6: 专家分析认为，台湾经济开年表现欠佳，增长压力不小。
column7: According to expert analysis, Taiwan's economy performed poorly at the beginning of the year, and the growth pressure is not small.

column6: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
column7: According to the financial affairs department of the Taiwan authorities, Taiwan's exports in January this year were 31.51 billion US dollars, an annual decrease of 21.2%, and it was the fifth consecutive month of negative growth.

column6: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
column7: Compared with the same period last year, the export value of 11 major export categories all declined.

column6: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
column7: <v>Plastic rubber</v> and its products, optical equipment fell the most, with an annual decrease of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

column6: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
column7: Exports of electronic components and components fell by 20.1% year-on-year, the largest decline in 11 years.

column6: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
column7: Among them, integrated circuits decreased by 18.3% year-on-year, the largest decline in 14 years.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
column7: <v>Cai Meina</v>, head of the statistics department of the department, said that this shows that the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry has spread, and the electronics industry has entered a correction period.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
column7: Cai Meina, head of the statistics department of the department, said that this shows that the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry has spread, and the electronics industry has <v>entered a correction period</v>.

column6: 统计显示，1月台湾地区进出口双降，出超金额仅23.4亿美元，创近3年来最低水平。
column7: Statistics show that Taiwan's imports and exports both fell in January, and the excess amount was only <v>US$2.34 billion</v>, the lowest level in nearly three years.‏‏‏‏

column6: 专家分析认为，台湾经济开年表现欠佳，增长压力不小。
column7: Experts analyze that Taiwan's economic performance at the beginning of the year is not good, and the pressure to grow is <v>not small</v>.

column6: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
column7: According to the <v>financial affairs department of the Taiwan authorities</v>, Taiwan's exports in January this year were 31.51 billion US dollars, a year-on-year decrease of 21.2%, and a negative growth for the fifth consecutive month.

column6: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
column7: The export volume of the 11 main export categories all declined compared to the same period last year.

column6: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
column7: Plastics, rubber and their products, and optical equipment had the <v>deepest</v> declines, with year-on-year decreases of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

column6: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
column7: Exports of electronic components decreased by 20.1% year-on-year, the largest decrease in 11 years.

column6: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
column7: Among them, integrated circuits decreased by 18.3% year-on-year, the largest decline in 14 years.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
column7: Cai Meina, the head of the department's statistics department, said that this shows that the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry is spreading, and the electronics industry is entering a <v>correction period</v>.

column6: 统计显示，1月台湾地区进出口双降，出超金额仅23.4亿美元，创近3年来最低水平。
column7: Statistics show that in January, Taiwan's imports and exports both fell, and the surplus was only 2.34 billion US dollars, the lowest level in nearly three years.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: Price Difference Compensation Reappears in Nanjing Real Estate Market - China News <v>Network</v>

column6: 扬子晚报讯(记者马祚波)扬子晚报/紫牛新闻记者10日在采访中发现，十余年未见的“保价协议”又重回了南京楼市，位于江北新区的一家楼盘宣称“差价赔付”，在交房前其他房源的优惠大于之前的折扣，开发商愿意为买房人换房并退还差价。
column7: Yangzi Evening News (Reporter Ma Zuobo) Yangzi Evening News/Zi Niu News reporter discovered in an interview on the 10th that the "price guarantee agreement" that has not been seen for more than ten years has returned to the Nanjing real estate market. A real estate project located in the Jiangbei New District claims "price difference compensation". If the discounts of other properties before the delivery are greater than the previous discounts, the developer is willing to change the house for the buyer and refund the difference.

column6: 在访问两国期间，范明政总理继续重申越南党和国家的对外路线，即独立自主，多元化，多变化，愿做所有国家的好朋友和可靠伙伴，以及国际社会的负责任成员。
column7: During his visit to the two countries, Prime Minister Fan Mingong continued to reaffirm the <v>external line</v> of Vietnam's party and state, namely, independence, pluralism, change, willingness to be a good friend and reliable partner of all countries, as well as a responsible member of the international community.

column6: 加强与新加坡和文莱的关系是各自国家的需求，致力于增进各自国家人民的福祉，致力于地区和世界的和平、稳定和发展。
column7: Strengthening relations with Singapore and Brunei is a requirement of their respective countries, committed to enhancing the well-being of their peoples and committed to regional and global peace, stability and development.

column6: 在各场会见和谈会上，范明政总理同新加坡和文莱领导人都一致同意通过高级代表团互访、有效开展各项双边合作机制和各项重要合作协议等方式不断增强与越南的政治互信。
column7: At various meetings and symposiums, Prime Minister <v>Fan Mingong</v>, along with the leaders of Singapore and Brunei, agreed to continuously strengthen political mutual trust with Vietnam through the exchange of high-level delegations, effective implementation of bilateral cooperation mechanisms and important cooperation agreements.

column6: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。
column7: Many cooperation documents were signed during the visit.

column6: 其中，与新加坡签署的《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》和与文莱签署的《2023-2027年阶段加强越文全面伙伴关系的行动计划》是两大亮点。
column7: Among them, the Memorandum of Understanding on Green and Digital Economy Partnership signed with Singapore and the Action Plan for Strengthening the Comprehensive Partnership <v>for Vietnam</v> in the 2023-2027 phase signed with Brunei are two highlights.

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
column7: Singapore's tourism industry rebounds strongly with a 19-fold increase in inbound tourists compared to 2021.

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it expects the number of international visitors to Singapore to reach 12 to 14 million by 2023, bringing in about 18 to 21 billion Singapore dollars in tourism revenue; the number of visitors and tourism revenue will recover to about 67% to 75% of the levels before the 2019 coronavirus pandemic; there is a high possibility of a full recovery in the tourism industry by 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: In 2022, the Singapore tourism market gradually restarted and recovered.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that the number of inbound tourists in 2022 increased 19 times from 330,600 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing the board's earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million. Tourism has now recovered to 33% of pre-pandemic levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's tourism revenue totaled 8.96 billion Singapore dollars. It is estimated that the total tourism revenue for 2022 can reach 13.8 to 14.3 billion Singapore dollars, an increase of 6 to 7 times compared to 1.89 billion Singapore dollars in 2021, and has recovered to about 50% to 52% of the level before the COVID-19 pandemic in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced a grant of nearly 500 million Singapore dollars to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The tourism board recently announced plans to allocate 110 million Singapore dollars from its budget over the next two years to introduce more commercial and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In order to make health and wellness a highlight of Singapore's tourism, the Singapore Tourism Board launched an intention solicitation event on November 23, 2022, planning to develop a health and wellness attraction on the southern coast of Singapore.

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
column7: <v>Wang Lingli</v>, the Executive Director of Sports and Wellness Tourism at the Singapore Tourism Board, said that in recent years, more and more tourists are putting their health first in their considerations.‏‏

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
column7: Singapore's tourism industry recovers strongly, with inbound tourists increasing 19 times compared to 2021

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: (<v>Comprehensive</v> news on the 11th) The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it is expected that the number of international tourists visiting Singapore in 2023 will reach 12 to 14 million, bringing about 18 to 21 billion Singapore dollars in tourism revenue; the number of tourists and tourism revenue will recover to about 67% to 75% of the level before the COVID-19 outbreak in 2019; there is a high possibility of a full recovery of the tourism industry in 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: In 2022, Singapore's tourism market gradually restarted and recovered.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that the number of inbound tourists in 2022 increased 19 times from 330,600 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing the earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million by the Tourism Board, and tourists have recovered to 33% of the level before the pandemic.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's tourism revenue totaled 8.96 billion Singapore dollars, and it is expected that the total tourism revenue for 2022 will reach 13.8 to 14.3 billion Singapore dollars, an increase of 6 to 7 times from 1.89 billion Singapore dollars in 2021, and has recovered to about 50% to 52% of the level before the COVID-19 outbreak in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced a grant of nearly 500 million Singapore dollars to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
column7: Singapore tourism recovery strong, inbound travelers up <v>19x</v> from 2021

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that 12 to 14 million international visitors are expected to visit Singapore in 2023, bringing about 18 to 21 billion yuan in tourism revenue; visitor numbers and tourism revenue will return to about 67 to 75 percent of pre-coronavirus levels in 2019; and there is a strong possibility of a full recovery in the tourism industry in 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: Singapore Tourism Market to be restarted and revived in <v>2022</v>

column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that inbound visitors in 2022 will increase 19-fold from <v>33.06 million</v> in 2021 to 6.3 million, exceeding the previous estimate of 4 to 6 million, and returning to 33 percent of pre-pandemic levels.

column6: 金正恩父女互动亲密老婆遭冷落一旁
column7: Kim Jong-un interacts intimately with his daughter, leaving his wife sidelined.

column6: （综合11日电）朝鲜8日晚间举行建军节第75周年阅兵仪式，领导人金正恩的女儿金主爱不仅出席，还与父亲一同站上主席台。
column7: (<v>Comprehensive report on the 11th</v>) On the evening of the 8th, North Korea held a military parade for the 75th anniversary of the founding of its army, and Kim Jong-un's daughter, Kim Ju-ae, not only attended, but also stood on the podium with her father.

column6: 朝鲜官媒9日公布影片，金主爱依偎在父亲身边，数次温情对视、讲悄悄话，她用双手轻捧老爸的脸颊，甚至摸著父亲胸口，父女互动画面播送至举国上下。
column7: North Korean state media released footage on the 9th showing Kim's daughter affectionately nestled by her father's side, exchanging tender glances and whispers. She gently cradled her father's cheeks with her hands and even touched his chest, with the father-daughter interaction being broadcast nationwide.

column6: 然而，第一夫人李雪主只能退到一旁。
column7: However, the First Lady, <v>Li Xue</v>, could only step aside.

column6: 综合韩国“朝鲜新闻”等报导，金正恩、李雪主夫妇7日带著女儿金主爱出席晚宴的官方合照中，金主爱不仅罕见坐在父母正中间C位，在隔日晚间建军节第75周年阅兵仪式上，她还与金正恩一起登上主席台。
column7: According to reports from South Korea's "Chosun News" and others, Kim Jong-un and his wife Ri Sol-ju brought their daughter Kim Ju-ae to a banquet on the 7th. In the official group photo, Kim Ju-ae not only sat in the middle between her parents, but also joined Kim Jong-un on the podium at the 75th anniversary military parade the next evening.

column6: 朝鲜官媒“朝鲜中央电视台”事后释出阅兵式影片，曝光了更多父女情深的画面。
column7: The North Korean official media "Korean Central Television" later released parade footage, revealing more scenes of deep father-daughter affection.

column6: 金正恩在主席台上数次与女儿对望，两人脸上的笑容从未退去，还互相在耳边讲悄悄话，金主爱一度以双手捧起老爸的两颊，金正恩也以灿笑回应。
column7: Kim Jong-un exchanged glances with his daughter several times on the podium, their smiles never fading, and they whispered to each other. At one point, Kim's daughter cupped her father's cheeks with her hands, to which Kim Jong-un responded with a bright smile.

column6: 其他官媒画面也显示，金主爱与金正恩坐在室内沙发椅上时，用手不断摸著父亲的脸；她与父亲挽著手走路时，一边用手摸在金正恩的胸口。
column7: Other official media images also showed Kim <v>Yo-jong</v> sitting with Kim Jong-un on an indoor sofa, constantly touching her father's face with her hand; when she walked hand in hand with her father, she touched Kim Jong-un's chest with her hand.

column7: <v>(Consolidated 11)</v> The Singapore Tourism Board (STB) recently announced that it expects international tourist arrivals to Singapore to reach 12 million to 14 million in 2023, which will bring in about S$18 billion to S$21 billion in tourism receipts; tourist arrivals and tourism receipts will recover to about 67% to 75% of the pre-Singaporean Crown Epidemic level of 2019; and there is a high likelihood that tourism will achieve a full recovery in 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: <v>Gradual re-launch and recovery of the Singapore tourism market in 2022</v>.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) show that visitor arrivals in 2022 have increased 19-fold to 6.3 million from 330,600 in 2021, surpassing the STB's earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million, with tourists having recovered to 33 percent of their pre-epidemic levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's tourism revenue totaled S$8.96 billion, and is expected to reach S$13.8 billion to S$14.3 billion for the full year of 2022, a six- to seven-fold increase from S$1.89 billion in 2021, and has already recovered to about 50% to 52% of its <v>pre-Singaporean Crown outbreak levels</v> in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government is taking a number of measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced the allocation of nearly S$500 million to stimulate tourism recovery.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Board has announced that it will plan to allocate S$110 million from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In an effort to make health and wellness one of Singapore's tourism highlights, the Singapore Tourism Board released a call for expressions of interest on November 23, 2022 to develop a health and wellness attraction on Singapore's southern coast.

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
column7: Ong Ling Li, Executive Director of Sports and Recreation Tourism at the Singapore Tourism Board, said that in recent years, more and more tourists are putting physical fitness at the top of their list of considerations.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: During his visits to the two countries, Prime Minister Pham Minh Trinh continued to reaffirm the <v>external line</v> of the Vietnamese Party and State, which is independence, pluralism and change, and willingness to be a good friend and reliable partner of all countries, as well as a responsible member of the international community.

column6: 加强与新加坡和文莱的关系是各自国家的需求，致力于增进各自国家人民的福祉，致力于地区和世界的和平、稳定和发展。
column7: Strengthening relations with Singapore and Brunei is a demand of their respective countries, which are committed to enhancing the well-being of their peoples and to peace, stability and development in the region and the world.

column6: 在各场会见和谈会上，范明政总理同新加坡和文莱领导人都一致同意通过高级代表团互访、有效开展各项双边合作机制和各项重要合作协议等方式不断增强与越南的政治互信。
column7: At the various meetings and talks, Prime Minister Pham Minh <v>Trung</v> and the leaders of Singapore and Brunei agreed to continuously enhance political mutual trust with Vietnam through the exchange of visits by high-level delegations, the effective implementation of various bilateral cooperation mechanisms and important cooperation agreements.

column6: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。
column7: Many cooperation documents were signed during the visit.

column6: 其中，与新加坡签署的《绿色和数字经济伙伴关系谅解备忘录》和与文莱签署的《2023-2027年阶段加强越文全面伙伴关系的行动计划》是两大亮点。
column7: Among them, the Memorandum of Understanding on the Green and Digital Economy Partnership signed with Singapore and the Action Plan on Strengthening the <v>Vietnam-Vietnam</v> Comprehensive Partnership for the Period 2023-2027 signed with Brunei are two highlights.

column7: Singapore's tourism industry is recovering strongly, with inbound travelers up 19 times from 2021

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: In 2022, Singapore's tourism market will gradually restart and recover.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that inbound travelers in 2022 increased 19-fold from 336,000 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing the Tourism Board's earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million, and tourists have recovered to 33% of the <v>pre-outbreak</v> levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's total tourism revenue totalled S$8.96 billion and is expected to reach S$13.8 billion to S$14.3 billion in 2022, an increase of six to seven times over S$1.89 billion in 2021, and has returned to about 50% to 52% of the pre-coronavirus levels in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken a number of steps to accelerate the recovery of tourism.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced nearly S$500 million to spur tourism recovery.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Authority has announced plans to allocate S$110 million from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities to attract travelers back.

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
column7: Strong tourism recovery in Singapore sees 19-fold increase in arrivals compared to 2021

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: (<v>Comprehensive, 11th</v>) The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it is estimated that the number of international tourists visiting Singapore in 2023 will reach 12 million to 14 million, which will bring about 18 billion to 21 billion Singapore dollars in tourism revenue; the number of tourists and tourism revenue It will return to the level of about 67% to 75% before the new crown epidemic in 2019; it is very likely that the tourism industry will fully recover in 2024.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced the allocation of nearly S$500 million to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Bureau announced a few days ago that it plans to allocate 110 million <v>Singapore dollars</v> from this budget in the next two years to launch more commercial and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In order to make health and wellness <v>one of the tourism highlights</v> in Singapore, the Singapore Tourism Board released a call for expressions of interest on November 23, 2022, planning to develop a health and wellness attraction on the south coast of Singapore.

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
column7: Wang Lingli, <v>executive director of sports and wellness tourism</v> of the Singapore Tourism Board, said that in recent years, more and more tourists put their health at the top of all considerations.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: According to expert analysis, Taiwan's economy performed poorly at the beginning of the year, and the <v>growth pressure</v> is not small.

column6: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
column7: According to the financial affairs department of the Taiwan authorities, Taiwan's exports in January this year were 31.51 billion US dollars, an annual decrease of 21.2%, and it was the fifth consecutive month of negative growth.

column6: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
column7: Compared with the same period last year, the export value of 11 major export categories all declined.

column6: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
column7: Plastic rubber and its products, optical equipment fell the most, with an annual decrease of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

column6: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
column7: Exports of electronic components <v>and components</v> fell by 20.1% year-on-year, the largest drop in 11 years.

column6: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
column7: Among them, integrated circuits decreased by 18.3% year-on-year, the largest decline in 14 years.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。

column7: <v>Yangtze Evening News (Reporter Ma Zuobo) Yangtze Evening News/Zin Niu News reporter</v> found in an interview on the 10th that the “price guarantee agreement” that has not been seen for more than ten years has returned to the Nanjing property market. A real estate in Jiangbei New District claims “price difference compensation”. Before the delivery of the house, the discount of other listings is greater than the previous discount, and the developer is willing to exchange the house for the buyer and refund the difference.

column7: The picture he sent to reporters shows that the developer of the real estate promised that anyone who purchases a listing from February 1st to February 28th <v>will be delivered to the corresponding listing</v> from the date of signing the sale and purchase contract between the two parties. column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Bureau announced a few days ago that it plans to allocate 110 million Singapore dollars from this budget in the next two years to launch more commercial and leisure activities to attract tourists to return.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In order to make health and wellness one of the tourism highlights in Singapore, the Singapore Tourism Board released a call for expressions of interest on November 23, 2022, planning to develop a health and wellness attraction on the south coast of Singapore.

column6: （<v>综合11日电</v>）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: The Singapore Tourism Board recently disclosed that it expects 12 to 14 million international visitors to visit Singapore in 2023, bringing in about S$18 billion to S$21 billion of tourism revenue; and that visitor arrivals and tourism revenue will recover to about 67% to 75% of pre-pandemic levels in 2019; and that a full-fledged recovery in the tourism industry in 2024, is very likely.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: The Singapore tourism market will be restarted and revived in 2022.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: Statistics released recently by the Singapore Tourism Board show that inbound visitors increased 19-fold to 6.3 million in 2022 from <v>33.06 million</v> in 2021, exceeding earlier estimates of 4 to 6 million, and has returned to 33 per cent of pre-pandemic levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: The Singapore tourism revenue, which totaled S$8.96 billion from January to September 2022, is expected to reach S$13.8 to S$14.3 billion for the full year of 2022, up six to seven times from the S$1.89 billion in 2021, having already recovered to a level of approximately 50% to 52% before the coronavirus outbreak in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: Singapore government has taken several steps to speed up the recovery of tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced nearly S$500 million to stimulate the tourism sector's recovery.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Ministry of Tourism recently announced that it plans to allocate about <v>110 million yuan</v> from the budget over the next two years to introduce more commercial and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 扬子晚报讯(记者马祚波)扬子晚报/紫牛新闻记者10日在采访中发现，十余年未见的“保价协议”又重回了南京楼市，位于江北新区的一家楼盘宣称“差价赔付”，在交房前其他房源的优惠大于之前的折扣，开发商愿意为买房人换房并退还差价。
column7: <v>Yangon Evening News</v> (Reporter Ma Zhongbo) Yangon Evening News / Zhuhai News reporter found in an interview on the 10th that the price guarantee agreement for the building, which has not been seen for more than ten years, has returned to the Nanjing real estate market. A property in Jiangbei New District claims that the price difference compensates for the building, and that the developer is willing to buy the house for the owner and refund the price difference.

column6: 2月10日，中国理财网发布首批个人养老金理财产品名单，工银理财、农银理财和中邮理财的7只个人养老金理财产品正式发售。
column7: On February 10, China Wealth Management Network released the list of the first batch of personal pension wealth management products. Seven personal pension wealth management products from ICBC Wealth Management, Agricultural Bank Wealth Management, and China Post Wealth Management were officially released.

column6: 至此，个人养老金账户的“货架”终于集齐个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财、个人养老金保险、个人养老金公募基金四类产品。
column7: At this point, the “shelf” of personal pension accounts has finally gathered four types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension financial management, personal pension insurance, and personal pension public funds.

column7: According to reports, the first batch of personal pension wealth management products were all <v>publicly funded net worth open products</v>, including 5 new products and 2 surviving products. column6: 首批56只融资融券标的股票名单以2023年1月31日为计算基准日确定。
column7: The list of the first batch of 56 stocks subject to margin financing and securities lending will be determined with January 31, 2023 as the calculation base date.

column6: 北交所表示，融资融券标的股票名单和可充抵保证金证券名单将通过北交所官网的“信息披露-融资融券信息”栏目公布，方便投资者查询。
column7: The <v>CBEX</v> stated that the list of stocks subject to margin financing and securities lending and the list of securities that can be used as margin will be published through the "Information Disclosure-Margin and Securities Lending Information" column of the CBEX's official website, which is convenient for investors to inquire.

column6: 北交所表示，融资融券标的股票名单和可充抵保证金证券名单将通过北交所官网的“信息披露-融资融券信息”栏目公布，方便投资者查询。
column7: The CBEX stated that the list of stocks subject to margin financing and securities lending and the list of securities that can be used as margin will be published through the "Information Disclosure-Margin and Securities Lending Information" column of the <v>CBEX's</v> official website, which is convenient for investors to inquire.

column6: 融资融券是证券市场重要的基础性制度，也是国际证券市场中较为成熟的交易方式。
column7: Margin financing and securities lending is an important basic system in the securities market, and it is also a relatively mature trading method in the international securities market.

column6: 去年9月2日，在宣布设立一周年之际，北交所对融资融券业务公开征求意见。
column7: On September 2 last year, on the occasion of announcing the first anniversary of its establishment, the Beijing Stock Exchange publicly solicited opinions on the margin financing and securities lending business.

column6: 北交所融资融券交易的启动是持续推进北交所市场制度建设、完善交易机制、提升二级市场定价功能的重要举措。
column7: The launch of the <v>CBEX's</v> margin trading and securities lending transaction is an important measure to continue to promote the construction of the CBEX's market system, improve the trading mechanism, and enhance the pricing function of the secondary market.

column6: 北交所融资融券交易的启动是持续推进北交所市场制度建设、完善交易机制、提升二级市场定价功能的重要举措。
column7: The launch of the CBEX's margin trading and securities lending transaction is an important measure to continue to promote the construction of the <v>CBEX's</v> market system, improve the trading mechanism, and enhance the pricing function of the secondary market.

column6: 融资融券制度有利于丰富投资者交易策略，满足投资者多元交易需求，促进市场价格发现，进一步提升市场流动性。
column7: The margin financing and securities lending system is conducive to enriching investors' trading strategies, meeting investors' diversified trading needs, promoting market price discovery, and further enhancing market liquidity.

column6: 下一步，北交所将在中国证监会的领导下，持续做好融资融券业务各项保障工作，以投资者需求为导向丰富交易制度工具，完善相关配套机制，着力打造服务创新型中小企业的一流交易所。
column7: In the next step, under the leadership of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the <v>CBEX</v> will continue to do a good job in various guarantees for the margin financing and securities lending business, enrich the trading system tools based on investor needs, improve relevant supporting mechanisms, and strive to create innovative services for small and medium-sized enterprises leading exchange.‏‏‏‏

column7: Yangzi Evening News reported (by reporter Ma Zuobo) that Yangzi Evening News/Zi Niu News reporters discovered in an interview on the 10th that the "<v>price protection agreement</v>", which had not been seen for more than ten years, has returned to the Nanjing property market. column7: The property located in Jiangbei New District is called Poly Yangzi Cuiyuntai. A prospective buyer, Mr. Sun, told reporters that he found a "statement" when he visited the property last weekend.

column6: 他发给记者的图片上显示，该楼盘的开发商承诺，凡是在2月1日-2月28日期间购买房源的，自双方签订买卖合同之日起至对应房源交付，若该项目其他房源的优惠折扣大于之前购房所享折扣的(限与该商品房属于同一户型、同一楼栋、同一单元、同一物业类型的其他未售商品房)，开发商可以为购房者换房并退还差价。

column6: NEWS GOV-MO: 香港大型考察团走访澳门旅游景点设施吸引港客并拓展港澳“联线同游”
column7: NEWS GOV-MO: A large-scale Hong Kong delegation visits tourist attractions and facilities in Macau to attract Hong Kong tourists and expand Hong Kong and Macau "<v>connected travel</v>"

column6: 旅游局组织由香港政府旅游部门、旅游业界及传媒代表组成超过100人的大型香港考察团到澳门，两天(10日及11日)的日程除了工作会议和业界洽谈，香港旅行社业界及传媒代表更分批走访澳门多个旅游景点、酒店及旅游相关设施，为香港市场引进最新的澳门旅游产品，同时促进两地文旅联动，共拓港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: The Tourism Bureau organized a large-scale Hong Kong delegation of more than 100 people from the tourism department of the Hong Kong government, tourism industry and media representatives to Macau. The two-day (10th and 11th) schedule included working meetings and industry talks, and Hong Kong travel agency industry and media representatives visited many tourist attractions, hotels and tourism-related facilities in Macau in batches to introduce the latest Macau tourism products to the Hong Kong market, and at the same time promote the linkage of cultural tourism between the two places, and jointly expand the market of "<v>connected travel</v>" between Hong Kong and Macau.

column6: 是次香港百人大型考察团包括香港政府旅游相关部门领导主管、60多位来自旅行社及港澳跨境交通营运商的代表以及约30位分别来自旅游杂志及报章的记者、旅游社交媒体、网络媒体代表及博客/网红等，亲临澳门交流考察，了解澳门最新旅游资源，香港业界及媒体将澳门旅游的新玩法带给香港居民以至访港旅客，藉香港交通枢纽的优势，拓展港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: The 100-person large-scale Hong Kong delegation includes leaders and directors of tourism-related departments of the Hong Kong government, more than 60 representatives from travel agencies and cross-border transportation operators from Hong Kong and Macau, and about 30 reporters from travel magazines and newspapers, travel social media, and Internet media representatives and bloggers/Internet celebrities, etc., will visit Macau for exchanges and investigations to learn about the latest tourism resources in Macau. column6: 2月10日，中国理财网发布首批个人养老金理财产品名单，工银理财、农银理财和中邮理财的7只个人养老金理财产品正式发售。
column7: On February 10th, China's Wealth Management Network released the first batch of <v>personal pension wealth management product list</v>, and seven personal pension wealth management products from ICBC Wealth Management, ABC Wealth Management, and Postal Savings Bank of China officially went on sale.

column6: 至此，个人养老金账户的“货架”终于集齐个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财、个人养老金保险、个人养老金公募基金四类产品。
column7: At this point, the "shelf" of personal pension accounts finally gathered four types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension wealth management, personal pension insurance, and public pension funds.

column6: 据介绍，首批个人养老金理财产品，全部为公募类净值型开放式产品，其中新发产品5只、存续产品2只，除1只产品为混合类产品外，其余6只产品均为固定收益类产品。

column6: 本报讯(记者孙杰)昨晚，北交所发布消息，经中国证监会批准，北京证券交易所融资融券交易业务将于2月13日正式启动，届时已取得北交所融资融券交易权限的证券公司可接受投资者委托，向北交所进行融资融券交易申报。
column7: (Reporter Sun Jie) Last night, the Beijing Stock Exchange announced that, with the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the margin trading business of the Beijing Stock Exchange will be officially launched on February 13, when securities companies that have obtained the margin trading authority of the Beijing Stock Exchange can accept the entrustment of investors to declare margin trading to the Beijing Stock Exchange.

column7: The list of the first 56 stocks subject to margin lending will be determined with January 31, 2023 as the base date for calculation.

column6: 旅游局组织由香港政府旅游部门、旅游业界及传媒代表组成超过100人的大型香港考察团到澳门，两天(10日及11日)的日程除了工作会议和业界洽谈，香港旅行社业界及传媒代表更分批走访澳门多个旅游景点、酒店及旅游相关设施，为香港市场引进最新的澳门旅游产品，同时促进两地文旅联动，共拓港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: MGTO organized a large-scale Hong Kong delegation of more than 100 people composed of representatives of the tourism department of the Hong Kong Government, the tourism industry and the media to Macao. In addition to work meetings and industry negotiations, the two-day (10th and 11th) schedule, representatives of the Hong Kong travel agency industry and the media also visited a number of tourist attractions, hotels and tourism-related facilities in Macao in batches to introduce the latest Macao tourism products to the Hong Kong market, while promoting cultural tourism linkage between the two places to jointly expand the “<v>online travel</v>” market in Hong Kong and Macao.

column6: 土叙地震救灾夜以继日
column7: Relief efforts for the Turkey-Syria earthquake continue day and night.

column6: 土耳其与相接的叙利亚发生强震以来，来自几十个国家的救援队日以继夜地在数千座震毁建筑的废墟中辛勤工作，解救被埋在瓦砾下的幸存者。
column7: Since the strong earthquake in Turkey and neighboring Syria, rescue teams from dozens of countries have been working day and night in the ruins of thousands of destroyed buildings, rescuing survivors buried under the rubble.

column6: 在冰冷的温度下，他们经常呼吁保持安静，因为他们竭力想从破旧的混凝土堆中听到任何生命的声音。
column7: In the freezing temperatures, they often called for silence as they strained to hear any signs of life from the rubble of the shattered concrete.

column6: 据路透社今天报道称，又有两名妇女在地震废墟中幸存数日后被救出。
column7: According to a Reuters report today, two more women were rescued after surviving several days in the rubble of the earthquake.

column6: 但是，地震造成的死亡人数攀升达24,150 人。
column7: However, the death toll from the earthquake rose to 24,150 people.

column6: 土耳其死亡人数为20,665 人，叙利亚死亡人数超过3,500 人。
column7: The death toll in Turkey was 20,665, while in Syria it exceeded 3,500.

column6: 周一发生的7.8 级地震，在土耳其和叙利亚继续发生了几次强烈余震，是本世纪第七大致命自然灾害，超过了日本2011 年的地震和海啸，接近2003 年邻国伊朗地震造成的31,000 人死亡。
column7: The 7.8 magnitude earthquake that occurred on Monday, followed by several strong aftershocks in Turkey and Syria, is the seventh deadliest natural disaster of this century, surpassing the 2011 earthquake and tsunami in Japan, and approaching the 31,000 deaths caused by the 2003 earthquake in neighbouring Iran.

column6: 1999 年在土耳其西北部发生的类似强烈地震造成17,000 多人丧生。
column7: A similar strong earthquake in the northwest of Turkey in 1999 resulted in the deaths of over 17,000 people.

column6: 土耳其当局周六表示，在该地区发生20 年来最致命的地震后，两名妇女被困122 小时，救援人员在土耳其从倒塌建筑物的废墟中救出了这两名妇女。
column7: Turkish authorities said on Saturday that two women were rescued from the rubble of a collapsed building by rescue workers in Turkey after being trapped for 122 hours, following the deadliest earthquake in the region in 20 years.

column6: 另一名受伤的55 岁男子被确认为Masallah Cicek，他是从土耳其东南部最大城市迪亚巴克尔一座倒塌建筑的废墟中救出来的。
column7: Another injured man, <v>55-year-old Masallah Cicek</v>, was identified as having been rescued from the rubble of a collapsed building in Diyarbakir, the largest city in southeastern Turkey.‏‏

column6: 新华社北京2月10日电中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平2月9日给第19批援助中非共和国的中国医疗队队员回信，向他们以及广大援外医疗队员致以问候并提出殷切期望。
column7: Xinhua News Agency, Beijing, February 10th, Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, wrote back to the 19th batch of Chinese medical team members assisting the Central African Republic on February 9th, extending greetings to them and the majority of foreign medical team members and putting forward ardent expectations.

column6: 习近平在回信中说，你们在中非克服工作生活上的困难，用心服务当地民众，既是救死扶伤的白衣天使，也是传递情谊的友好使者。
column7: In his reply, Xi Jinping said that <v>you</v> have overcome the difficulties of work and life in Central Africa and served the local people with your heart. You are not only angels in white who save lives and injuries, but also friendly messengers who convey friendship.

column7: He Lifeng pointed out that holding this forum is an important measure to implement the consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Fumio Kishida in Bangkok, and to strengthen <v>China-Japan green development cooperation</v>.

column7: On February 11, the 16th China-Japan Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection Comprehensive Forum was held in Beijing.

column6: 中共中央政治局委员、国家发展改革委主任何立峰出席主论坛并发表主旨演讲。
column7: He Lifeng, member of the Politburo of the CPC Central Committee and head of the National Development and Reform Commission, attended the main forum and delivered a keynote speech.

column6: 何立峰指出，举办本届论坛是落实习近平主席和岸田文雄首相曼谷会晤共识、加强中日绿色发展合作的重要举措。
column7: He pointed out that the holding of the forum is an important measure to implement the consensus <v>reached at the meeting between President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Fumio Kishida in Bangkok</v> and to strengthen China-Japan cooperation for green development.

column6: 中国将全面贯彻落实中共二十大精神，加快发展方式绿色转型，深入推进环境污染防治，全面加强资源节约，积极稳妥推进碳达峰碳中和，协同推进降碳、减污、扩绿、增长，推进生态优先、节约集约、绿色低碳发展。
column7: China will fully implement the spirit of the Twentieth Congress of the Communist Party of China, accelerate the green transformation of its development model, further promote the prevention and control of environmental pollution, enhance the conservation of resources, actively and steadily promote <v>carbon neutrality</v>, promote carbon reduction, pollution reduction, green expansion and growth in a coordinated manner, and promote ecological priority, conservation intensive and green low-carbon development.

column6: 旅游局组织由香港政府旅游部门、旅游业界及传媒代表组成超过100人的大型香港考察团到澳门，两天(10日及11日)的日程除了工作会议和业界洽谈，香港旅行社业界及传媒代表更分批走访澳门多个旅游景点、酒店及旅游相关设施，为香港市场引进最新的澳门旅游产品，同时促进两地文旅联动，共拓港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: The Tourism Bureau organized a large delegation of over 100 people from the Hong Kong government's tourism department, the tourism industry, and media representatives to visit Macau. In addition to work meetings and industry discussions during the two-day (10th and 11th) schedule, representatives from the Hong Kong travel agency industry and media visited various tourist attractions, hotels, and tourism-related facilities in Macau in batches. This is to introduce the latest Macau tourism products to the Hong Kong market, while promoting cultural and tourism linkage between the two places, and jointly expanding the "<v>Hong Kong-Macau Joint Tour</v>" market.

column6: 土叙地震救灾夜以继日
column7: Turkey-Syria Earthquake Relief <v>Works Day and Night</v>

column6: 土耳其与相接的叙利亚发生强震以来，来自几十个国家的救援队日以继夜地在数千座震毁建筑的废墟中辛勤工作，解救被埋在瓦砾下的幸存者。
column7: Since the powerful earthquake hit Turkey and neighboring Syria, rescue teams from dozens of countries have been working day and night among the rubble of thousands of destroyed buildings to free survivors buried under the rubble.

column6: 在冰冷的温度下，他们经常呼吁保持安静，因为他们竭力想从破旧的混凝土堆中听到任何生命的声音。
column7: In freezing temperatures, they often called for silence as they struggled to hear any sound of life from the dilapidated concrete piles.

column6: 据路透社今天报道称，又有两名妇女在地震废墟中幸存数日后被救出。
column7: Reuters reported today that two more women had been rescued after surviving days in the rubble of the quake.

column6: 但是，地震造成的死亡人数攀升达24,150 人。
column7: However, the death toll from the quake climbed to 24,150.

column6: 土耳其死亡人数为20,665 人，叙利亚死亡人数超过3,500 人。
column7: The death toll in Turkey <v>stands</v> at 20,665 and in Syria more than 3,500.

column6: 周一发生的7.8 级地震，在土耳其和叙利亚继续发生了几次强烈余震，是本世纪第七大致命自然灾害，超过了日本2011 年的地震和海啸，接近2003 年邻国伊朗地震造成的31,000 人死亡。
column7: Monday's 7.8-magnitude quake, which continued with several powerful aftershocks in Turkey and Syria, was the seventh deadliest natural disaster this century, surpassing Japan's 2011 earthquake and tsunami and approaching the 2003 quake in neighboring Iran that killed 31,000 people.

column6: 1999 年在土耳其西北部发生的类似强烈地震造成17,000 多人丧生。
column7: A similarly powerful earthquake in northwestern Turkey in 1999 killed more than 17,000 people.

column6: 土耳其当局周六表示，在该地区发生20 年来最致命的地震后，两名妇女被困122 小时，救援人员在土耳其从倒塌建筑物的废墟中救出了这两名妇女。
column7: Rescuers have pulled two women from the rubble of collapsed buildings in Turkey after they were trapped for 122 hours after the region's deadliest earthquake in 20 years, Turkish authorities said Saturday.

column6: 另一名受伤的55 岁男子被确认为Masallah Cicek，他是从土耳其东南部最大城市迪亚巴克尔一座倒塌建筑的废墟中救出来的。
column7: Another injured man, identified as Masallah Cicek, 55, was rescued from the rubble of a collapsed building in Diyarbakir, Turkey's largest city in southeastern Turkey.‏‏‏‏
