column6: 新华社北京2月11日电2月11日，第十六届中日节能环保综合论坛以线上线下相结合方式在北京举办。
column7: Beijing, 11 Feb (Xinhua) -- On 11 February, <v>the 16th China-Japan Comprehensive Forum on Energy Conservation and Environmental Protection</v> was held in Beijing in a combination of online and offline mode.

column6: 中共中央政治局委员、国家发展改革委主任何立峰出席主论坛并发表主旨演讲。
column7: He Lifeng, member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and chairman of the National Development and Reform Commission, attended the main forum and delivered a keynote speech.

column6: 何立峰指出，举办本届论坛是落实习近平主席和岸田文雄首相曼谷会晤共识、加强中日绿色发展合作的重要举措。
column7: He Lifeng pointed out that holding this forum is an important measure to implement the consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Fumio Kishida in Bangkok and strengthen China-Japan cooperation in green development.

column7: This real estate in Jiangbei New District is called Poly Yangzi Cuiyuntai. The buyer, Mr. Sun, told reporters that he found a “statement” when he visited the real estate last weekend.

column6: 他发给记者的图片上显示，该楼盘的开发商承诺，凡是在2月1日-2月28日期间购买房源的，自双方签订买卖合同之日起至对应房源交付，若该项目其他房源的优惠折扣大于之前购房所享折扣的(限与该商品房属于同一户型、同一楼栋、同一单元、同一物业类型的其他未售商品房)，开发商可以为购房者换房并退还差价。
column7: The picture he sent to reporters shows that the developer of the real estate promised that anyone who purchases a listing from February 1st to February 28th <v>will be delivered to the corresponding listing from the date of signing the sale and purchase contract between the two parties</v>. If the discount of other listings in the project is greater than the discount enjoyed by the previous purchase (limited to other unsold commercial properties of the same type, the same building, the same unit, and the same property type as the commercial house), the developer can exchange the house for the buyer and refund the difference.

column7: Margin trading is an important basic system in the securities market and a relatively mature trading method in the international securities market.

column7: On September 2 last year, on the occasion of its first anniversary, the Beijing Stock Exchange publicly solicited opinions on margin trading.

column6: 北交所融资<v>融券</v>交易的启动是持续推进北交所市场制度建设、完善交易机制、提升二级市场定价功能的重要举措。
column7: The launch of the Beijing Stock Exchange's margin trading is an important measure to continuously promote the construction of the Beijing Stock Exchange's market system, improve the trading mechanism, and enhance the pricing function of the secondary market.

column6: 融资融券制度有利于丰富投资者交易策略，满足投资者多元交易需求，促进市场价格发现，进一步提升市场流动性。
column7: The margin trading system is beneficial to enrich investors' trading strategies, meet investors' diversified trading needs, promote market price discovery, and further enhance market liquidity.

column6: 下一步，北交所将在中国证监会的领导下，持续做好融资融券业务各项保障工作，以投资者需求为导向丰富交易制度工具，完善相关配套机制，着力打造服务创新型中小企业的一流交易所。
column7: Next, under the leadership of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Beijing Stock Exchange will continue to do a good job in all aspects of margin trading, enrich trading system tools oriented by investor demand, improve related supporting mechanisms, and strive to build a first-class exchange serving innovative small and medium-sized enterprises.<v>"</v>‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: At the meetings and talks, Prime Minister Pham Minh <v>Thanh</v> and the leaders of Singapore and Brunei agreed to continuously enhance political mutual trust with Vietnam through the exchange of high-level delegations, effective implementation of bilateral cooperation mechanisms and important cooperation agreements.

column6: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。

column7: <v>Turkey-Syria Earthquake Relief Works Day and Night</v>

column6: 土耳其与相接的叙利亚发生强震以来，来自几十个国家的救援队日以继夜地在数千座震毁建筑的废墟中辛勤工作，解救被埋在瓦砾下的幸存者。
column7: Rescue teams from dozens of countries have been working around the clock in the rubble of thousands of destroyed buildings to free survivors buried under the rubble since the powerful earthquake hit Turkey and neighboring Syria.

column6: 在冰冷的温度下，他们经常呼吁保持安静，因为他们竭力想从破旧的混凝土堆中听到任何生命的声音。
column7: In freezing temperatures, they often called for silence as they struggled to hear any sound of life from the dilapidated concrete piles.

column6: 据路透社今天报道称，又有两名妇女在地震废墟中幸存数日后被救出。
column7: Reuters reported today that two more women had been rescued after surviving days in the devastation of the quake.

column6: 但是，地震造成的死亡人数攀升达24,150 人。
column7: However, the death toll from the quake climbed to 24,150.

column6: 土耳其死亡人数为20,665 人，叙利亚死亡人数超过3,500 人。
column7: The death toll in Turkey <v>stands</v> at 20,665 and in Syria more than 3,500.

column6: 周一发生的7.8 级地震，在土耳其和叙利亚继续发生了几次强烈余震，是本世纪第七大致命自然灾害，超过了日本2011 年的地震和海啸，接近2003 年邻国伊朗地震造成的31,000 人死亡。
column7: Monday's 7.8-magnitude quake, which continued with several powerful aftershocks in Turkey and Syria, was the seventh deadliest natural disaster this century, surpassing Japan's 2011 earthquake and tsunami and approaching the 2003 quake in neighboring Iran that killed 31,000 people <v>die</v>.

column6: 本报讯(记者孙杰)昨晚，北交所发布消息，经中国证监会批准，北京证券交易所融资融券交易业务将于2月13日正式启动，届时已取得北交所融资融券交易权限的证券公司可接受投资者委托，向北交所进行融资融券交易申报。
column7: News from <v>this newspaper</v> (Reporter Sun Jie) Last night, the Beijing Stock Exchange released news that with the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the financing and securities trading business of the Beijing Stock Exchange will be officially launched on February 13. At that time, securities companies that have obtained the Beijing Stock Exchange's securities financing transaction authority can accept requests from investors to report financing and securities transactions to the Beijing Stock Exchange.

column7: News from this newspaper (Reporter Sun Jie) Last night, the Beijing Stock Exchange released news that with the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the financing and securities trading business of the Beijing Stock Exchange will be officially launched on February 13. column7: The list of the first batch of 56 securities financing stocks was determined using January 31, 2023 as the calculation base date.

column6: 北交所表示，融资融券标的股票名单和可充抵保证金证券名单将通过北交所官网的“信息披露-融资融券信息”栏目公布，方便投资者查询。
column7: The Beijing Stock Exchange said that the list of stocks <v>covered</v> by securities financing and the list of securities that can be used as security deposits will be published through the “Information Disclosure - Securities Finance Information” section of the Beijing Stock Exchange's official website to facilitate investors' inquiries.

column6: 融资融券是证券市场重要的基础性制度，也是国际证券市场中较为成熟的交易方式。
column7: Securities financing is an important basic system in the securities market, and it is also a more mature transaction method in the international securities market.

column6: 去年9月2日，在宣布设立一周年之际，北交所对融资融券业务公开征求意见。
column7: On September 2 of last year, on the occasion of announcing the first anniversary of its establishment, the Beijing Stock Exchange solicited public comments on securities financing and securities lending business.

column6: 北交所融资<v>融券</v>交易的启动是持续推进北交所市场制度建设、完善交易机制、提升二级市场定价功能的重要举措。
column7: The launch of securities financing transactions on the Beijing Stock Exchange is an important measure to continue to promote the Beijing Stock Exchange's market system construction, improve the trading mechanism, and enhance the pricing function of the secondary market.

column6: 融资融券制度有利于丰富投资者交易策略，满足投资者多元交易需求，促进市场价格发现，进一步提升市场流动性。
column7: The securities financing system is conducive to enriching investors' trading strategies, meeting investors' diversified trading needs, promoting market price discovery, and further enhancing market liquidity.

column6: 下一步，北交所将在中国证监会的领导下，持续做好融资融券业务各项保障工作，以投资者需求为导向丰富交易制度工具，完善相关配套机制，着力打造服务创新型中小企业的一流交易所。
column7: In the next step, under the leadership of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Beijing Stock Exchange will continue to do a good job of safeguarding the financing and securities lending business, enrich trading system tools guided by investors' needs, improve relevant supporting mechanisms, and focus on building a first-class exchange serving innovative small and medium-sized enterprises.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: 新华社北京2月10日电中共中央总书记、国家主席、中央军委主席习近平2月9日给第19批援助中非共和国的中国医疗队队员回信，向他们以及广大援外医疗队员致以问候并提出殷切期望。
column7: On February 10, Xinhua News Agency reported that Xi Jinping, General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President of the State, and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, responded on February 9 to a letter from the 19th batch of Chinese medical team members assisting the Central African Republic, extending his greetings and expressing his earnest expectations to them and to the majority of medical team members assisting abroad.

column7: In his reply, Xi Jinping said that you have overcome difficulties in work and life in <v>Africa</v>, served the local people with heart, and are not only angels in white who save lives and help the injured, but also friendly messengers who convey friendship.

column6: 习近平在回信中说，你们在中非克服工作生活上的困难，用心服务当地民众，既是救死扶伤的白衣天使，也是传递情谊的友好使者。
column7: In his reply, Xi Jinping said that you have overcome difficulties in work and life in Africa, served the local people with heart, and are not only <v>angels in white</v> who save lives and help the injured, but also friendly messengers who convey friendship.

column6: 他发给记者的图片上显示，该楼盘的开发商承诺，凡是在2月1日-2月28日期间购买房源的，自双方签订买卖合同之日起至对应房源交付，若该项目其他房源的优惠折扣大于之前购房所享折扣的(限与该商品房属于同一户型、同一楼栋、同一单元、同一物业类型的其他未售商品房)，开发商可以为购房者换房并退还差价。
column7: The picture he sent to reporters shows that the developer of the real estate promises that if the property is purchased between February 1 and February 28, from the date of signing the sales contract between the two parties to the delivery of the corresponding listing, if the discount of other listings in the project is greater than the discount enjoyed by the previous purchase (limited to other unsold commercial <v>houses</v> belonging to the same type, the same building, the same unit, and the same property type as the commercial house), the developer can exchange houses for the buyer and refund the difference.

column6: 孙先生表示，置业顾问表示这其实就是一份“保价协议”，目的是让买家放心出手，不用担心开发企业降价促销，“现在就怕买完了它就降价了，去售楼处闹吧没时间，不闹的话也确实窝心”。
column7: Mr. Sun said that the property consultant said that this is actually a "<v>price insurance agreement</v>", the purpose of which is to let buyers feel at ease, do not have to worry about the development company's price reduction promotion, "now I am afraid that after buying it, I will reduce the price, go to the sales office to make trouble, there is no time, if you do not make trouble, it is indeed comfortable."

column6: 去年9月2日，在宣布设立一周年之际，北交所对融资融券业务公开征求意见。
column7: On September 2 last year, on the occasion of the first anniversary of its establishment, the Beijing Stock Exchange publicly solicited opinions on margin trading and securities lending.

column6: 北交所融资<v>融券</v>交易的启动是持续推进北交所市场制度建设、完善交易机制、提升二级市场定价功能的重要举措。
column7: The launch of margin trading on the BSE is an important measure to continuously promote the construction of the BSE market system, improve the trading mechanism, and improve the pricing function of the secondary market.

column6: 融资融券制度有利于丰富投资者交易策略，满足投资者多元交易需求，促进市场价格发现，进一步提升市场流动性。
column7: The margin trading system is conducive to enriching investors' trading strategies, meeting investors' diversified trading needs, promoting market price discovery, and further enhancing market liquidity.

column6: 下一步，北交所将在中国证监会的领导下，持续做好融资融券业务各项保障工作，以投资者需求为导向丰富交易制度工具，完善相关配套机制，着力打造服务创新型中小企业的一流交易所。
column7: In the next step, under the leadership of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Beijing Stock Exchange will continue to do a good job in guaranteeing margin trading and securities lending, enrich trading system tools guided by investor needs, improve relevant supporting mechanisms, and strive to build a first-class exchange serving innovative small and medium-sized enterprises.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: BEIJING, Feb. 10 (Xinhua) -- General Secretary of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, President of the State and Chairman of the Central Military Commission, Xi Jinping, wrote back to the members of the 19th batch of Chinese medical team assisting the Central African Republic on February 9, greeting them and the majority of foreign medical team members and raising ardent expectations.

column7: Xi Jinping said in his letter that <v>you</v> have overcome the difficulties of your working life in Central Africa and served the local people with heart, both as white-clothed angels who save the dead and the wounded, but also as friendly messengers who convey friendship.

column7: Medical aid is an important part of <v>our</v> foreign aid work.

column7: In 1963, our country sent the first foreign medical support team to Algeria.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: 土叙地震救灾夜以继日
column7: Earthquake relief in Turkey and Syria continues around the clock

column6: 土耳其与相接的叙利亚发生强震以来，来自几十个国家的救援队日以继夜地在数千座震毁建筑的废墟中辛勤工作，解救被埋在瓦砾下的幸存者。
column7: Since <v>the powerful earthquake in Turkey's bordering Syria</v>, rescue teams from dozens of countries have been working day and night in the rubble of thousands of quake-damaged buildings to free survivors buried under the rubble.

column6: 在冰冷的温度下，他们经常呼吁保持安静，因为他们竭力想从破旧的混凝土堆中听到任何生命的声音。
column7: In the freezing temperatures, they often appealed for silence as they tried desperately to hear any sounds of life from the crumbling piles of concrete.

column6: 据路透社今天报道称，又有两名妇女在地震废墟中幸存数日后被救出。
column7: Two more women have been rescued after surviving days in the earthquake rubble, Reuters reported today.

column6: 但是，地震造成的死亡人数攀升达24,150 人。
column7: However, the death toll from the earthquake climbed to 24,150.

column6: 土耳其死亡人数为20,665 人，叙利亚死亡人数超过3,500 人。
column7: The death toll in Turkey was 20,665 and in Syria more than 3,500.

column6: 周一发生的7.8 级地震，在土耳其和叙利亚继续发生了几次强烈余震，是本世纪第七大致命自然灾害，超过了日本2011 年的地震和海啸，接近2003 年邻国伊朗地震造成的31,000 人死亡。
column7: Monday's 7.8-magnitude quake, which continued with several powerful aftershocks in Turkey and Syria, was the seventh deadliest natural disaster of the century, surpassing Japan's 2011 quake and tsunami, and approaching the 31,000 deaths caused by <v>an</v> earthquake in neighboring Iran in 2003.

column6: 1999 年在土耳其西北部发生的类似强烈地震造成17,000 多人丧生。
column7: A similarly powerful earthquake in northwestern Turkey in 1999 killed more than 17,000 people.

column6: 土耳其当局周六表示，在该地区发生20 年来最致命的地震后，两名妇女被困122 小时，救援人员在土耳其从倒塌建筑物的废墟中救出了这两名妇女。
column7: Rescuers in Turkey rescued two women from the rubble of collapsed buildings after they were trapped for 122 hours following the region's deadliest earthquake in 20 years, authorities said Saturday.

column6: 另一名受伤的55 岁男子被确认为Masallah Cicek，他是从土耳其东南部最大城市迪亚巴克尔一座倒塌建筑的废墟中救出来的。
column7: Another injured 55-year-old man, identified as Masallah Cicek, was rescued from the rubble of a collapsed building in Diyarbakir, Turkey's largest city in the southeast.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: NEWS GOV-MO: 香港大型考察团走访澳门旅游景点设施吸引港客并拓展港澳“联线同游”
column7: NEWS GOV-MO: A large Hong Kong delegation visits tourist attractions in Macau to attract Hong Kong tourists and expand the "<v>joint travel</v>" between Hong Kong and Macau.

column6: 旅游局组织由香港政府旅游部门、旅游业界及传媒代表组成超过100人的大型香港考察团到澳门，两天(10日及11日)的日程除了工作会议和业界洽谈，香港旅行社业界及传媒代表更分批走访澳门多个旅游景点、酒店及旅游相关设施，为香港市场引进最新的澳门旅游产品，同时促进两地文旅联动，共拓港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: The Tourism Bureau organized a large-scale Hong Kong inspection team of over 100 people, composed of representatives from the Hong Kong government's tourism department, the tourism industry, and the media, to visit Macau. The two-day (10th and 11th) itinerary included not only work meetings and industry discussions, but also visits to various tourist attractions, hotels, and tourism-related facilities in Macau by representatives of the Hong Kong travel agency industry and the media. This was done to introduce the latest Macau tourism products to the Hong Kong market, while also promoting cultural and tourism linkage between the two places, and jointly developing the Hong Kong-Macau "<v>connected travel</v>" market.

column6: 据Wind数据显示，截至2022年底，国内共有公募基金管理人156家，管理基金规模约26万亿元；公募基金份额登记机构167家，公募基金销售机构411家。
column7: According to Wind data, as of the end of 2022, there were 156 public fund managers in China, managing about 26 trillion yuan in funds; there were 167 public fund share registration institutions and 411 public fund sales institutions.

column6: 各份额登记机构账户体系相互独立，缺乏行业统一的查询渠道。
column7: The account systems of each share registration institution are independent of each other, lacking a unified industry query channel.

column7: Strengthening relations with Singapore and Brunei is a necessity for each country, <v>committed to enhancing the welfare of their respective peoples and contributing to regional and global peace, stability, and development</v>.

column6: 在各场会见和谈会上，范明政总理同新加坡和文莱领导人都一致同意通过高级代表团互访、有效开展各项双边合作机制和各项重要合作协议等方式不断增强与越南的政治互信。
column7: In all meetings and talks, Prime Minister <v>Fan Mingzheng</v> and the leaders of Singapore and Brunei unanimously agreed to continuously strengthen political mutual trust with Vietnam through high-level delegation visits, effective implementation of bilateral cooperation mechanisms, and various important cooperation agreements.

column6: 许多合作文件在此次访问期间得到了签署。
column7: <v>Many</v> cooperative documents were signed during this visit.

column7: Among them, the "Memorandum of Understanding on Green and Digital Economy Partnership" signed with Singapore and the "Action Plan to Strengthen the Comprehensive Partnership between Vietnam and Brunei for the 2023-2027 period" <v>were</v> two highlights.

column7: Yangzi Evening News (Reporter Ma Zuobo) Yangzi Evening News/Zi Niu News reporter discovered in an interview on the 10th that the "<v>price guarantee agreement</v>" that has not been seen for more than ten years has returned to the Nanjing real estate market. A real estate project located in the Jiangbei New District claims "price difference compensation". If the discounts of other properties before the delivery are greater than the previous discounts, the developer is willing to change the house for the buyer and refund the difference.

column7: On February 10, China Wealth Management Network released the first batch of <v>personal pension wealth management</v> products, and seven personal pension wealth management products from ICBC Wealth Management, ABC Wealth Management, and China Post Wealth Management officially went on sale.

column6: 【环球时报驻比利时特派记者牛瑞飞】据法新社2月10日报道，在当天最新的一次欧盟峰会上，欧盟委员会主席冯德莱恩表示，欧盟领导人同意就非法移民问题出台更严格的政策，以此更易于驱逐非法移民。
column7: According to AFP, at the latest EU summit on February 10, European Commission President Jean-Claude Juncker said that EU leaders had agreed to a stricter policy on illegal immigration to make it easier to deport illegal immigrants.

column6: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
column7: The move was reportedly a response to the EU's growing concern about illegal immigration, which is now at the heart of the EU's problem with the small number of illegal immigrants who can ultimately be <v>returned</v>.

column6: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
column7: According to the summit documents, EU leaders called on the Commission to immediately mobilize large amounts of EU funds to strengthen the external borders, including infrastructure and surveillance.

column6: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
column7: However, the EU and its member states are still in dispute over the payment of fencing fees and other issues.

column6: 中新网北京2月11日电(门睿)近日发布的《2022中国海归就业调查报告》(下称“报告”)显示，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高，我国企业对海外人才的需求亦呈上扬态势。

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report pointed out that since 2020, the number of overseas <v>returnees</v> seeking jobs in China has significantly increased, with a rise in the number of recent graduates studying abroad returning to seek employment.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared to 2021, the number of new <v>graduates</v> studying abroad in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of returning students seeking jobs in their home country reached a new high.

column6: 从回国求职留学生的留学国家分布来看，英国占比最高，为41.4%，其次是澳大利亚(20.3%)和美国(9%)，排名与2021年一致。
column7: Looking at the distribution of study abroad countries for returning job-seeking students, the UK had the highest proportion at 41.4%, followed by Australia (20.3%) and the US (9%), the ranking was consistent with 2021.

column6: 从同比增速来看，2022年来自马来西亚、日本、新加坡的应届留学生人数同比大幅上升，增速分别为66.1%、50.9%和37.7%。
column7: Looking at the year-on-year growth rate, the number of new international students from Malaysia, Japan, and Singapore significantly increased in 2022, with growth rates of 66.1%, 50.9%, and 37.7% respectively.

column6: 来自加拿大、德国、美国、澳大利亚的应届留学生人数同比下降。
column7: The number of <v>recent graduates studying abroad</v> from Canada, Germany, the United States, and Australia has decreased compared to the previous year.

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: ( Comprehensive 11th) The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it is expected that the number of international tourists visiting Singapore in 2023 will reach 12 million to 14 million, which will bring about 18 billion to 21 billion Singapore dollars in tourism revenue. column6: 央视网消息：种植牙是很多缺牙患者的理想选择，但一直以来，动辄上万元一颗的价格让很多患者望而却步。
column7: CCTV News: Dental implants are the ideal choice for many patients with missing teeth, but for a long time, the price of tens of thousands of dollars per piece has discouraged many patients.

column6: 今年以来，随着种植牙集采的加速落地，各地也将种植牙降价提上日程。
column7: Since the beginning of this year, with the acceleration of centralized procurement of dental implants, price reductions for dental implants have also been put on the agenda in various places.

column6: 从2月10日起，河南省单颗常规种植牙医疗服务价格全流程调控目标为4300元，单颗常规种植全流程费用不高于调控目标的97%。
column7: From February 10th, the whole-process regulatory target for the price of a single conventional dental implant medical service in Henan Province is 4,300 yuan, and the cost of the entire process of a single conventional dental implant <v>is</v> not higher than 97% of the regulatory target.

column6: 种植牙齿指的是一种以植入骨组织内的下部结构为基础来支持、固位上部牙修复体的缺牙修复方式。
column7: Dental implant refers to a method of restoring missing teeth based on the underlying structure implanted in bone tissue to support and retain the upper tooth restoration.

column6: 中新网北京2月11日电(门睿)近日发布的《2022中国海归就业调查报告》(下称“报告”)显示，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高，我国企业对海外人才的需求亦呈上扬态势。
column7: Beijing, Feb. 11 (Menrui) -- According to the "2022 China Returnee Employment Survey Report" (hereinafter referred to as the "Report") recently released, the <v>scale</v> of fresh international students in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, the number of international students returning to China to seek employment reached a new high, and the demand for overseas talents by Chinese enterprises also showed an upward trend.

column6: 央视网消息：种植牙是很多缺牙患者的理想选择，但一直以来，动辄上万元一颗的价格让很多患者望而却步。
column7: CCTV News: Dental implants are the ideal choice for many patients with missing teeth, but for a long time, the price of tens of thousands of dollars per piece has <v>discouraged</v> many patients.

column6: 今年以来，随着种植牙集采的加速落地，各地也将种植牙降价提上日程。
column7: Since the beginning of this year, with the acceleration of centralized procurement of dental implants, price reductions for dental implants have also been put on the agenda in various places.

column6: 从2月10日起，河南省单颗常规种植牙医疗服务价格全流程调控目标为4300元，单颗常规种植全流程费用不高于调控目标的97%。

column6: 中新网北京2月11日电(门睿)近日发布的《2022中国海归就业调查报告》(下称“报告”)显示，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高，我国企业对海外人才的需求亦呈上扬态势。
column7: BEIJING, Feb. 11 (Xinhua) -- The recently released "2022 China <v>Returnee</v> Employment Survey Report" (hereinafter referred to as the "Report") shows that the scale of fresh international students in 2022 has increased by 8.6% year-on-year, the number of international students returning to China to seek employment has reached a new high, and the demand of Chinese enterprises for overseas talents has also shown an upward trend.

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report noted that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking jobs within China has grown significantly, and the number of fresh international students returning to <v>their home countries</v> has increased.

column7: The Singapore government is taking a number of measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced the allocation of nearly S$500 million to stimulate tourism recovery.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Board has announced that it will plan to allocate S$110 million from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In an effort to make health and wellness one of Singapore's tourism highlights, the Singapore Tourism Board released a call for expressions of interest on November 23, 2022 to develop a health and wellness attraction on Singapore's southern coast.

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
column7: Singapore's tourism industry recovers strongly, with arrivals 19 times higher than in 2021

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: The Singapore Tourism Board (STB) recently announced that the number of international tourists visiting Singapore in 2023 is expected to reach 12 million to 14 million, which will bring about S$18 billion to S$21 billion in tourism revenue.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: The Singapore tourism market will gradually <v>restart</v> and recover in 2022.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: According to the latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board, tourist arrivals in 2022 increased 19-fold to 6.3 million from 330,600 in 2021, surpassing the board's earlier estimate of 4 million to 6 million, and tourists have <v>recovered to</v> 33% of pre-pandemic levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年<v>新冠疫情</v>前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's tourism revenue totalled S$8.96 billion, and is expected to reach S$13.8 billion to S$14.3 billion in 2022, a six- to seven-fold increase from S$1.89 billion in 2021, and has recovered to about 50 to 52 per cent of pre-2019 levels.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced nearly S$500 million to stimulate tourism recovery.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Board has announced plans to allocate S$110 million from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities to attract visitors back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: To make health and wellness one of Singapore's tourism highlights, the Singapore Tourism Board (STB) launched a call for expressions of interest on 23 November 2022 to develop a health and wellness attraction on Singapore's south coast.

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
column7: 'In recent years, more and more tourists have put their health at the top of their list of considerations,' said Wang Ling-li, executive director of sports and wellness tourism at the Singapore Tourism Board.‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: According to the latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board, visitor arrivals in 2022 increased <v>19-fold</v> from 330,600 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing MGTO's earlier estimate of 4 million to 6 million, and tourists have recovered to 33% of pre-pandemic levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: Singapore's tourism revenue from January to September 2022 totalled S$8.96 billion, and is expected to reach S$13.8 billion to S$14.3 billion <v>for the whole year</v> 2022, up six to seven times from S$1.89 billion in 2021 and recovering to about 50% to 52% of pre-pandemic levels in 2019.

column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of tourism.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the Government announced a allocation of nearly S$500 million to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: <v>MGTO</v> has announced that it plans to allocate S$110 million from the budget over the next two years to introduce more business and leisure activities to attract visitors back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: To make wellness one of Singapore's highlights, the Singapore Tourism Board has released a call for expressions on <v>23 November</v> 2022 to develop a wellness attraction on Singapore's southern coast.

column6: 央视网消息：种植牙是很多缺牙患者的理想选择，但一直以来，动辄上万元一颗的价格让很多患者望而却步。
column7: <v>According to</v> CCTV News: Dental implants are the ideal choice for many patients with missing teeth, but the cost, often tens of thousands per tooth, has deterred many.

column6: 今年以来，随着种植牙集采的加速落地，各地也将种植牙降价提上日程。
column7: Since the beginning of this year, with the accelerated implementation of centralized procurement of dental implants, various places have also put the price reduction of dental implants on the agenda.

column6: 从2月10日起，河南省单颗常规种植牙医疗服务价格全流程调控目标为4300元，单颗常规种植全流程费用不高于调控目标的97%。
column7: Starting from February 10, the full-process price control target for conventional dental implant medical services in Henan Province is <v>4300</v> yuan, and the full-process cost of a single conventional implant should not exceed 97% of the control target.

column6: 种植牙齿指的是一种以植入骨组织内的下部结构为基础来支持、固位上部牙修复体的缺牙修复方式。
column7: Dental <v>implantation</v> refers to a method of tooth restoration that uses an underlying structure implanted in the bone tissue to support and stabilize the upper dental prosthesis.

column6: 记者从郑州大学第一附属医院了解到，以单颗常规种植为例，从种植到最后修复，价格大概要一万六七千元左右。
column7: Reporters learned from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University that, taking a single conventional implant as an example, the price from <v>implantation</v> to final restoration is about 16,000 to 17,000 yuan.

column6: 患者何莹：新政策之后，大夫跟我说，像我这种情况差不多就是8000多元、不到1万元，基本上能省一半。
column7: Patient He Ying: <v>After the new policy</v>, the doctor told me that in my case, it would be around 8,000 yuan, less than 10,000 yuan, basically saving half.

column7: (Comprehensive news on the 11th) The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it is expected that the number of international tourists visiting Singapore in 2023 will reach 12 to 14 million, bringing about 18 to 21 billion Singapore dollars in tourism revenue; the number of tourists and tourism revenue will recover to about 67% to 75% of the level before the COVID-19 outbreak in 2019; there is a high possibility of a full recovery of the tourism industry in 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: In 2022, Singapore's tourism market gradually restarted and recovered.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that the number of inbound tourists in 2022 increased 19 times from 330,600 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing the earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million by the Tourism Board, and tourists have recovered to 33% of the level before the pandemic.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's tourism revenue totaled 8.96 billion Singapore dollars, and it is expected that the total tourism revenue for 2022 will reach 13.8 to 14.3 billion Singapore dollars, an increase of 6 to 7 times from 1.89 billion Singapore dollars in 2021, and has recovered to about 50% to 52% of the level before the COVID-19 outbreak in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced a grant of nearly 500 million Singapore dollars to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The Tourism Board recently announced that it plans to allocate 110 million Singapore dollars from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In order to make health and wellness one of the highlights of Singapore's tourism, the Singapore Tourism Board launched a call for proposals on November 23, 2022, planning to develop a health and wellness attraction on the southern coast of Singapore.

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
column7: <v>Wang Lingli</v>, Executive Director of Sports and Wellness Tourism at the Singapore Tourism Board, said that in recent years, more and more tourists have put physical health at the top of their considerations.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍
column7: Singapore's tourism industry is recovering strongly, with inbound travelers up 19 times from 2021

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it expects 12 million to 14 million international tourists to visit Singapore in 2023, which will bring about about S$18 billion to 21 billion in tourism revenue; passenger traffic and tourism <v>income</v> will return to about 67% to 75% of the pre-coronavirus levels in 2019; and the possibility of a full recovery of the tourism industry in 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: In 2022, Singapore's tourism market will gradually <v>restart</v> and recover.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that inbound travelers in 2022 increased 19-fold from 336,000 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing the Tourism Board's earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million, and tourists have recovered to 33% of the pre-outbreak levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's total tourism revenue totalled S$8.96 billion and is expected to reach S$13.8 billion to S$14.3 billion in 2022, an increase of six to seven times over S$1.89 billion in 2021, and has returned to about 50% to 52% of the pre-<v>coronavirus</v> levels in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken a number of steps to accelerate the recovery of tourism.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced nearly S$500 million to spur tourism recovery.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The <v>Tourism Authority</v> has announced plans to allocate S$110 million from this budget over the next two years to launch more business and leisure activities to attract travelers back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: To make health and wellness one of Singapore's tourist highlights, Tourism Singapore launched a call for proposals on 23 November 2022 to develop a health and wellness attraction on Singapore's southern coast.

column6: 新加坡旅游局体育与康养旅游执行署长王凌丽说，近年来，越来越多的游客把身体健康放在各项考虑因素的首位。
column7: Wang Lingli, Executive Director of Sports and Recreation Tourism, Tourism Singapore, said that in recent years, more and more tourists <v>have</v> put their health at the top of their list of considerations.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: <url>, Beijing, February 11 (Menrui) The recently released “2022 China <v>Returnee</v> Employment Survey Report” (hereinafter referred to as the "Report") shows that the scale of fresh international students in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job search hit a new high. column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report points out that since 2020, the number of <v>returnees</v> looking for jobs in China has increased significantly, and the number of fresh international students returning to China for jobs has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the number of <v>fresh international students</v> in 2022 increased by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job search hit a new high.

column6: 报告指出，自2020年以来，在中国国内求职的海归数量明显增长，回国求职的应届留学生数量增多。
column7: The report pointed out that since 2020, the number of returnees seeking jobs in China has increased significantly, and the number of fresh graduates returning to China to seek jobs has increased.

column6: 与2021年相比，2022年应届留学生规模同比增长8.6%，回国求职留学生数量再创新高。
column7: Compared with 2021, the number of international students graduating in 2022 will increase by 8.6% year-on-year, and the number of international students returning to China for job hunting <v>will</v> hit a new high.

column6: 新加坡旅游业复苏强劲入境旅客比2021年增长19倍

column6: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
column7: The EU's move is reportedly a response to growing concerns about illegal immigration in Europe, which now centers on the small number of illegal immigrants who can eventually be <v>sent back</v>.

column6: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
column7: According to the summit document, EU leaders called on the Commission to "immediately <v>mobilise</v> significant EU funding" to strengthen external borders with infrastructure and surveillance, among other things.

column6: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
column7: However, the EU is <v>at loggerheads</v> with member states over issues such as payment for the fence.

column7: <v>"Julio</v> Rios, a well-known Spanish expert on China and honorary advisor to the China Policy Watch Network, recently told our reporter in an interview that China's epidemic prevention and control has entered a new stage, and the vitality of economic and social development will be further released.

column6: 里奥斯表示，面对各种超预期因素冲击，中国以非凡的经济治理经验和措施沉着应对，充分体现出其经济韧性和管理水平。
column7: Rios stated that in the face of various unexpected factors, China has responded calmly with extraordinary economic governance experience and measures, fully demonstrating its economic resilience and management level.

column6: 中国坚定不移扩大对外开放的同时，经济发展的内生动力不断增强，国有企业和民营企业协同发展。
column7: While China is steadfast in expanding its openness to the outside world, the <v>endogenous</v> driving force of economic development is constantly strengthening, with state-owned enterprises and private enterprises developing in coordination.

column6: 每年中国全国两会召开，代表委员共商国家发展大计、共议民生热点问题，广泛凝聚共识、凝聚人心、凝聚智慧，为中国发展增添力量。
column7: Every year, the <v>two sessions</v> of the National People's Congress of China are held, where representatives and members discuss major national development plans and hot issues concerning people's livelihoods, widely gathering consensus, rallying public support, and pooling wisdom to add strength to China's development.

column6: 种植牙齿指的是一种以植入骨组织内的下部结构为基础来支持、固位上部牙修复体的缺牙修复方式。
column7: Dental implants refer to a method of repairing missing teeth based on the lower structure implanted in the bone tissue to support and fix the upper dental prosthesis.

column6: 记者从郑州大学第一附属医院了解到，以单颗常规种植为例，从种植到最后修复，价格大概要一万六七千元左右。
column7: Reporters learned from the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University that, taking a single conventional implant as an example, the price from implantation to final repair is about 16,000 to 17,000 yuan.

column6: 患者何莹：新政策之后，大夫跟我说，像我这种情况差不多就是8000多元、不到1万元，基本上能省一半。
column7: Patient He Ying: After the new policy, the doctor told me that in my case, it would be about 8,000 yuan, less than 10,000 yuan, basically <v>saving half</v>.

column6: 在现行项目基础上，河南省还整合确定了“种植体植入费(单颗)”等15个口腔种植类医疗服务价格项目，并统一制定省管公立医疗机构价格和医保支付类别，取消或调整了牙种植体植入术等20个医疗服务价格项目。
column7: On the basis of the current project, Henan Province has also integrated and determined 15 oral implant medical service price items such as "implant implantation fee (single)", and uniformly formulated the price and medical insurance payment category of provincial public medical institutions, and cancelled or adjusted 20 medical service price items such as dental implant surgery.

column6: 郑州市医疗保障局医药价格和招标采购处处长李云杰：受益的主要是四方，一个是医保，医保的支出少了；医院的占压少了，病人会适当增加；对供应商来说得到了一个市场；对我们患者来说是得利最大的一方，植一颗牙的费用可能要减半甚至更多。
column7: Li Yunjie, Director of the Medical Price and <v>Tendering and Procurement</v> Department of Zhengzhou Medical Security Bureau: The main beneficiaries are four parties, one is medical insurance, which reduces the expenditure of medical insurance; the hospital's occupancy is reduced, and patients will increase appropriately; for suppliers, they have gained a market; for our patients, they are the biggest beneficiaries, the cost of implanting a tooth may be halved or even more.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: （综合11日电）新加坡旅游局近日公布，预计2023年到访新加坡的国际旅客人次可达1200万至1400万，将带来约180亿至210亿新元的旅游收益；旅客人次和旅游收入将恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约67%至75%的水平；2024年旅游业实现全面复苏的可能性很大。
column7: The Singapore Tourism Board recently announced that it <v>expects</v> the number of international visitors to Singapore to reach 12 to 14 million by 2023, bringing in about 18 to 21 billion Singapore dollars in tourism revenue; the number of visitors and tourism revenue will recover to about 67% to 75% of the levels before the 2019 coronavirus pandemic; there is a high possibility of a full recovery in the tourism industry by 2024.

column6: 2022年新加坡旅游市场逐步重新启动和恢复。
column7: In 2022, the Singapore tourism market gradually <v>restarted</v> and recovered.

column6: 新加坡旅游局最新发布的统计数据显示，2022年入境旅客从2021年的33.06万人次增长19倍，达到630万人次，超越旅游局早前预估的400万至600万人次，游客已经恢复至疫情前33%的水平。
column7: The latest statistics released by the Singapore Tourism Board show that the number of inbound tourists in 2022 increased 19 times from 330,600 in 2021 to 6.3 million, surpassing the board's earlier estimate of 4 to 6 million. Tourism has now recovered to 33% of pre-pandemic levels.

column6: 2022年1月至9月，新加坡旅游收入共计89.6亿新元，预计2022年全年旅游收入可达138亿至143亿新元，比2021年的18.9亿新元增长6倍至7倍，已经恢复到2019年新冠疫情前约50%至52%的水平。
column7: From January to September 2022, Singapore's tourism revenue totaled 8.96 billion Singapore dollars. It is estimated that the total tourism revenue for 2022 can reach 13.8 to 14.3 billion Singapore dollars, an increase of 6 to 7 times compared to 1.89 billion Singapore dollars in 2021, and has recovered to about 50% to 52% of the level before the COVID-19 pandemic in 2019.

column6: 新加坡政府多措并举，加速旅游业复苏。
column7: The Singapore government has taken multiple measures to accelerate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 2022年4月，政府宣布拨款近5亿新元用来刺激旅游业复苏。
column7: In April 2022, the government announced a grant of nearly 500 million Singapore dollars to stimulate the recovery of the tourism industry.

column6: 旅游局日前宣布，将计划在未来两年从这笔预算中拨出1.1亿新元，推出更多商业和休闲活动吸引旅客回流。
column7: The <v>tourism board</v> recently announced plans to allocate 110 million Singapore dollars from its budget over the next two years to introduce more commercial and leisure activities to attract tourists back.

column6: 为了使健康养生成为新加坡的旅游亮点之一，新加坡旅游局在2022年11月23日发布了一份意向征集活动，计划在新加坡南部海岸开发一个健康养生景点。
column7: In order to make health and wellness a highlight of Singapore's tourism, the Singapore Tourism Board launched an <v>intention solicitation event</v> on November 23, 2022, planning to develop a health and wellness attraction on the southern coast of Singapore.

column7: [Global Times special correspondent in Belgium, Niu Ruifei] According to a report by Agence France-Presse on February 10, at the latest EU summit that day, the President of the European Commission, Ursula von der Leyen, stated that EU leaders agreed to implement stricter policies on illegal immigration, making it easier to deport illegal immigrants.

column6: 据报道，欧盟此举是对欧洲日益增长的非法移民问题关注的回应，如今，欧盟的核心问题在于，最终能被遣返的非法移民人数很少。
column7: The report said that this move by the EU is a response to the growing concern about the problem of illegal immigration in Europe. Now, the core issue for the EU is that very few illegal immigrants can ultimately be deported.

column6: 根据峰会文件，欧盟领导人呼吁委员会“立即调动大量欧盟资金”，以基础设施和监视等手段加强外部边界。
column7: According to summit documents, EU leaders called on the Commission to "immediately mobilize a large amount of EU funds" to strengthen external borders through infrastructure and surveillance.

column6: 然而，欧盟与各成员国就围栏费用支付等问题争吵不休。
column7: However, the EU and its member states are endlessly arguing over issues such as the payment of fence costs.

column7: But some member states' diplomats said that if the EU could share part of the cost of installing cameras, watchtowers, and other infrastructure along the external border, it would free up national budgets and speed up the construction process.

column6: <v>亲临考察</v>引入澳门旅游新玩法
column7: Introduce a new way of tourism in Macau

column6: 是次香港百人大型考察团包括香港政府旅游相关部门领导主管、60多位来自旅行社及港澳跨境交通营运商的代表以及约30位分别来自旅游杂志及报章的记者、旅游社交媒体、网络媒体代表及博客/网红等，亲临澳门交流考察，了解澳门最新旅游资源，香港业界及媒体将澳门旅游的新玩法带给香港居民以至访港旅客，藉香港交通枢纽的优势，拓展港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: The 100-person <v>large-scale</v> Hong Kong delegation includes leaders and directors of tourism-related departments of the Hong Kong government, more than 60 representatives from travel agencies and cross-border transportation operators from Hong Kong and Macau, and about 30 reporters from travel magazines and newspapers, travel social media, and Internet media representatives and bloggers/Internet celebrities, etc., will visit Macau for exchanges and investigations to learn about the latest tourism resources in Macau. The Hong Kong industry and media will bring new ways of traveling in Macau to Hong Kong residents and tourists, and take advantage of Hong Kong's transportation hub to expand the market of "connected travel" between Hong Kong and Macau.

column6: 吸引香港旅客拓展港澳“联线同游”
column7: Attracting Hong Kong Visitors and Expanding Hong Kong and Macao "Connected Travel"

column6: 乘着通关复常的契机，旅游局铺开了香港市场的宣传攻势及推出各项优惠，其中包括推出了往返港澳交通票务优惠，以崭新的宣传片于线上线下平台投放广告等。
column7: Taking advantage of the resumption of customs clearance, MGTO launched a promotional campaign in the Hong Kong market and launched various offers, including the launch of round-trip transportation ticketing offers to Hong Kong and Macau, and the launch of new promotional videos on online and offline platforms.

column6: 继上月邀请香港旅游业界领袖来澳交流考察及香港网红亲身体验澳门“旅游+”，这次再度组织香港旅游业界及传媒代表来澳考察，加大市场推广力度，吸引香港旅客来澳留宿消费，两地业界更洽商携手拓展港澳“联线同游”市场，共拓内地以至海外市场，促进两地旅游业复苏。
column7: Following the invitation of Hong Kong tourism industry leaders to visit Macao last month and the experience of Macao's "Tourism+" by Hong Kong internet celebrities, this time <v>we once again organised a visit to Macao by representatives of the Hong Kong tourism industry and the media</v>, stepped up marketing efforts to attract Hong Kong tourists to stay and spend in Macao, and the industry of the two places also discussed joint efforts to expand the "online and travel" market in Hong Kong and Macao, jointly expand the mainland and overseas markets, and promote the recovery of tourism in the two places.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: In the 80s of the last century, Zheng Yonggang was the factory manager of a state-owned cotton spinning factory. Following his transfer, Zheng Yonggang became the factory manager of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the predecessor of Shanshan Co., Ltd. in 1989.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th <v>Annual Conference of Chinese Business Leaders</v> and the 22nd Annual Conference of Chinese Business Future Stars, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the Chinese suit market in the 90s of the last century, the market share of the Shanshan brand was as high as 37 percent.

column7: Just when the clothing business was in full swing, the Shanshan Group began to transform because Zheng Yonggang realized, “Once the market is liberalized, Chinese brands will naturally form an echelon brand market. <v>Shanshan Western clothing has always dominated the style</v>, and it is unlikely that it will become the national uniform of the Chinese people for a long time.”

column6: 1999年，杉杉开始研究企业转型，郑永刚回忆当年， “ 我们来到上海，寻求到底转型做什么，专门找了很多专家学者，连续不断地开一些诸葛亮会、务虚研讨会。
column7: In 1999, Shanshan began to study enterprise transformation. Zheng Yonggang recalled <v>that year</v>, "We came to Shanghai to find out what to do in transformation. We specially found many experts and scholars, and held some Zhuge Liang meetings and retreat seminars continuously.

column6: 最后，我们设定了两个大的战略方向。
column7: Finally, we set two major strategic directions.

column6: 第一个方向是新能源新材料，另外一个是大健康有未来” 。
column7: The first direction is new energy and new materials, and the other is that great health has a future."

column6: 战略方向确定后，杉杉开始寻找合作，那时候鞍山热能院为鞍钢配套的炭素研究所在做国家863课题，科研经费不够，于是杉杉和鞍山热能院碳素研究所签署合作协议，共同推动国家863课题“中间相炭微球”项目产业化，从事负极材料的研发、生产和销售，在国内实现负极材料的商用推广。

column7: The Tourism Bureau organized a large-scale Hong Kong delegation of more than 100 people from the tourism department of the Hong Kong Government, the tourism industry and the media to Macau. column6: 最近，美国对华“芯片战”大有升级之势——先是荷兰、日本两国在美国施压下，同意启动对华半导体制造设备出口的管制；后有外媒报道，美国政府正考虑切断美国供应商与华为公司之间的所有联系，禁止美国供应商向华为提供任何产品；拜登政府还准备公布一项行政命令，限制美国对敏感的中国科技行业的投资……2023年开年不久，美国在遏制中国半导体相关产业发展上就恶招不断。
column7: Recently, the U.S. "chip war" against China has been escalating. First, under the pressure of the U.S., the Netherlands and Japan agreed to start controlling the export of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China; later, foreign media reported that the U.S. government is considering cutting off All connections between U.S. suppliers and Huawei, prohibiting U.S. suppliers from supplying any products to Huawei; the Biden administration is also preparing to issue an executive order to restrict U.S. investment in the sensitive Chinese technology industry... <v>2023 will soon begin</v> However, the United States has continued to make evil moves to curb the development of China's semiconductor-related industries.

column7: In 1999, Shanshan began to study enterprise transformation. Zheng Yonggang recalled that year, "We came to Shanghai to find out what to do in transformation. We specially found many experts and scholars, and held some Zhuge Liang meetings and retreat seminars continuously.

column6: 上世纪80年代，郑永刚担任国营棉纺厂的厂长，随着调任，1989年郑永刚成为杉杉股份的前身宁波云港服装总厂的厂长。
column7: In the 1980s, Zheng Yonggang served as the director of a state-owned cotton spinning factory, and with his transfer, he became the director of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the predecessor of Shanshan Shares, in 1989.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th <v>China Business Leaders Annual Meeting</v> and the 22nd China Future Stars Annual Meeting, Zheng Yonggang stated in his speech that in the Chinese suit market of the 1990s, the market share of the Shanshan brand once reached as high as 37%.

column6: 据华尔街日报今天报道称，气球事件后，美国准备进一步收紧对华技术出口。
column7: According to a Wall Street Journal report today, after the balloon incident, the United States is preparing to further tighten technology exports to China.

column6: 现任和前任安全官员表示，上述气球事件突显了中国构成的国家安全威胁，并将为加强美国技术保护争取更多政治支持。
column7: Current and former security officials said the balloon incident highlighted the national security threat posed by China and would garner more political support for stronger U.S. technology protections.

column6: 美国称该气球携带了用于情报收集和通信的天线和传感器。
column7: The United States said the balloon carried antennas and sensors for intelligence gathering and communications.

column7: According to Martijn Rasser, a former senior CIA official now at the Center for a New American Security, a Washington think tank<v>.</v>

column6: “这无疑是火上浇油，支持了对华强硬派的观点”。
column7: This is undoubtedly adding fuel to the fire and supporting the views of the hardliners on China.

column6: 白宫新闻秘书卡琳·让-皮埃尔(Karine Jean-Pierre)周四对记者表示，“我们还将考虑采取更大范围的行动，以揭露和应对中国更大规模的监视活动，这些活动对我们的国家安全以及我们的盟友和伙伴构成威胁。
column7: White House press secretary Karine Jean-Pierre told reporters on Thursday, "We will also consider <v>broader actions</v> to expose and respond to China's larger surveillance activities that pose threats to our national security and to our allies and partners.

column6: <v>”</v>美国官员说，他们已向30多个国家的政府通报了上述气球事件的情况，国际协调对于应对中国威胁至关重要。
column7: U.S. officials said they had notified the governments of more than 30 countries about the balloon incident and that international coordination was crucial to countering the Chinese threat.

column6: 至此，个人养老金账户的“货架”终于集<v>齐</v>个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财、个人养老金保险、个人养老金公募基金四类产品。
column7: So far, the "shelves" of personal pension accounts have finally collected four types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension wealth management, personal pension insurance, and personal pension public funds.

column6: 据介绍，首批个人养老金理财产品，全部为公募类净值型开放式产品，其中新发产品5只、存续产品2只，除1只产品为混合类产品外，其余6只产品均为固定收益类产品。
column7: According to reports, the first batch of personal pension wealth management products are all open-ended public offering net worth products, including 5 new products and 2 existing products. column7: Recently, the U.S. "chip war" against China has been escalating. column6: 两天紧密行程觅商机增宣传
column7: <v>Two days of intensive travel, opportunity to consult, more publicity</v>

column6: 考察团于昨今两天分组参观世界遗产“澳门历史城区”、体验澳门大赛车博物馆、“时空穿梭‧游历三巴” —— 大三巴牌坊沉浸式数字体验展、澳品荟、氹仔旧城区，以及多个大型度假村酒店及设施：上葡京、The Karl Lagerfeld、永利皇宫、美狮美高梅、摩珀斯、澳门伦敦人、澳门银河、新濠天地的Artelli多维艺术空间及澳门威尼斯人的teamLab超自然空间等。
column7: For the two day tour the group visited the World Heritage site in Macau historical city, <v>Macau Motorcycle Museum</v>, time and space touring, the 3 Bars, the Big Bar Bar, the immersive digital experience exhibition, Macau Wine and Cheeses Old City, as well as major resort hotels and facilities: Upper Portugal, The Karl Lagerfeld, Eternal Palace, American Lion and Max, Perth, Macau Londoners, Macau Galaxy, the new world of Artelli multi-dimensional art space and Macau Venetian supernatural space teamLab among others.

column7: The MGTO organized a large-scale Hong Kong <v>study tour</v> of more than 100 people composed of representatives from the tourism department of the Hong Kong Government, the tourism industry and the media to Macau. column7: On February 10, China Wealth Management Network released the list of the first batch of personal pension wealth management products. column6: 至此，个人养老金账户的“货架”终于集<v>齐</v>个人养老金储蓄、个人养老金理财、个人养老金保险、个人养老金公募基金四类产品。
column7: At this point, the “shelf” of personal pension accounts has finally gathered four types of products: personal pension savings, personal pension financial management, personal pension insurance, and personal pension public funds.

column6: 据介绍，首批个人养老金理财产品，全部为公募类净值型开放式产品，其中新发产品5只、存续产品2只，除1只产品为混合类产品外，其余6只产品均为固定收益类产品。
column7: According to reports, the first batch of personal pension wealth management products were all publicly funded net worth open products, including 5 new products and 2 <v>surviving</v> products. column7: Recently, the U.S. "chip war" against China has escalated significantly - first, the Netherlands and Japan agreed to start controls on the export of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China under U.S. pressure; later, foreign media reported that the U.S. government is considering cutting off all ties between U.S. suppliers and Huawei and banning U.S. suppliers from supplying Huawei with any products; the Biden administration is also preparing to issue an executive order restricting U.S. investment in sensitive Chinese technology industries...

column6: 最近，美国对华“芯片战”<v>大</v>有升级之势——先是荷兰、日本两国在美国施压下，同意启动对华半导体制造设备出口的管制；后有外媒报道，美国政府正考虑切断美国供应商与华为公司之间的所有联系，禁止美国供应商向华为提供任何产品；拜登政府还准备公布一项行政命令，限制美国对敏感的中国科技行业的投资……2023年开年不久，美国在遏制中国半导体相关产业发展上就恶招不断。
column7: Recently, the US "chip war" against China has shown signs of escalating - first, under US pressure, the Netherlands and Japan agreed to initiate controls on the export of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China; then foreign media reported that the US government is considering severing all ties between US suppliers and Huawei, prohibiting US suppliers from providing any products to Huawei; the Biden administration is also preparing to announce an executive order restricting US investment in China's sensitive technology industries... Shortly after the start of 2023, the US has been relentless in its efforts to curb the development of China's semiconductor-related industries.

column6: 是次香港百人大型考察团包括香港政府旅游相关部门领导主管、60多位来自旅行社及港澳跨境交通营运商的代表以及约30位分别来自旅游杂志及报章的记者、旅游社交媒体、网络媒体代表及博客/网红等，亲临澳门交流考察，了解澳门最新旅游资源，香港业界及媒体将澳门旅游的新玩法带给香港居民以至访港旅客，藉香港交通枢纽的优势，拓展港澳“联线同游”市场。
column7: The large Hong Kong delegation of 100 people includes leaders of the Hong Kong government's tourism-related departments, more than 60 representatives from travel agencies and cross-border transportation operators in Hong Kong and Macau, and about 30 representatives from tourism magazines and newspapers, social media, online media, bloggers/influencers, etc. They visited Macau to <v>understand</v> the latest tourism resources in Macau. The Hong Kong industry and media will bring new ways to play in Macau to Hong Kong residents and tourists visiting Hong Kong, and expand the "Hong Kong-Macau Joint Tour" market with the advantage of Hong Kong's transportation hub.

column7: The United States escalates its "chip war" and <v>hits the global semiconductor industry hard</v>-Chinanews.com

column6: 经济观察网记者郑淯心2月11日，认证主体为杉杉控股有限公司（以下简称“杉杉控股” ） 的微信公众号发布讣告，杉杉企业创始人、杉杉控股董事局主席郑永刚因突发心脏疾病<v>救治无效</v>，于2023年2月10日去世，享年65岁。
column7: Economic Observer Network reporter Zheng Yu Xin, February 11, the WeChat public account certified by Shanshan Holdings Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Shanshan Holdings") announced that Zheng Yonggang, the founder of Shanshan Enterprises and the chairman of the board of directors of Shanshan Holdings, died of a sudden heart disease on February 10, 2023, at the age of 65.

column6: 经济观察网记者郑淯心2月11日，认证主体为杉杉控股有限公司（以下简称“杉杉控股” ） 的微信公众号发布讣告，杉杉企业创始人、杉杉控股董事局主席郑永刚因突发心脏疾病救治无效，于2023年2月10日去世，享年65岁。
column7: Economic Observer Network reporter Zheng <v>Yu Xin</v>, February 11, the WeChat public account certified by Shanshan Holdings Limited (hereinafter referred to as "Shanshan Holdings") announced that Zheng Yonggang, the founder of Shanshan Enterprises and the chairman of the board of directors of Shanshan Holdings, died of a sudden heart disease on February 10, 2023, at the age of 65.

column6: 上世纪80年代，郑永刚担任国营棉纺厂的厂长，随着调任，1989年郑永刚成为杉杉股份的前身宁波云港服装总厂的厂长。
column7: In the 1980s, Zheng Yonggang served as the director of a state-owned cotton spinning factory. With his transfer, in 1989, Zheng Yonggang became the director of Ningbo Yungang Garment Factory, the predecessor of Shanshan Shares.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th <v>China Enterprise Leaders Annual Meeting</v> and the 22nd China Future Stars Annual Meeting, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the Chinese suit market in the 1990s, the market share of Shanshan brand once reached 37%.

column6: 2022年12月，在第二十届中国企业领袖年会暨第二十二届中国企业未来之星年会上，郑永刚在演讲中称，在上世纪90年代的中国西服市场，杉杉品牌的市占率曾高达37 % 。
column7: In December 2022, at the 20th China Enterprise Leaders Annual Meeting and the 22nd <v>China Future Stars Annual Meeting</v>, Zheng Yonggang said in his speech that in the Chinese suit market in the 1990s, the market share of Shanshan brand once reached 37%.

column6: 1996年杉杉股份（600884.SH）上市，成为中国服装业第一家上市公司。
column7: In 1996, Shanshan Shares (600884.SH) was listed, becoming the first listed company in China's clothing industry.

column6: 就在服装业务如日中天时，杉杉集团却开始转型，因为郑永刚意识到， “ 一旦市场放开，中国品牌自然会形成一个梯队式品牌市场，杉杉西服想一直独领风骚，长期成为国人的国服的可能性不大” 。
column7: Just when the clothing business was booming, Shanshan Group began to transform, because Zheng Yonggang realized that "once the market is opened, Chinese brands will naturally form a tiered brand market, and it is not likely that Shanshan suits will always lead the trend and become the national dress of the Chinese people in the long term".

column6: 1999年，杉杉开始研究企业转型，郑永刚回忆当年， “ 我们来到上海，寻求到底转型做什么，专门找了很多专家学者，连续不断地开一些诸葛亮会、务虚研讨会。
column7: In 1999, Shanshan began to study corporate transformation. Zheng Yonggang recalled that year, "We came to Shanghai to find out what to transform, and specifically sought many experts and scholars, and continuously held some Zhuge Liang meetings and theoretical seminars.

column7: In 1999, Shanshan began to study enterprise transformation. Zheng Yonggang recalled that year, "We came to Shanghai to find out what to do in transformation. We specially found many experts and scholars, and held some Zhugeliang meetings and retreat seminars continuously.

column6: 最后，我们设定了两个大的战略方向。
column7: Finally, we set two major strategic directions.

column6: 第一个方向是新能源新材料，另外一个是大健康有未来” 。
column7: The first direction is new energy and new materials, and the other is that great health has a future."

column6: 战略方向确定后，杉杉开始寻找合作，那时候鞍山热能院为鞍钢配套的炭素研究所在做国家863课题，科研经费不够，于是杉杉和鞍山热能院碳素研究所签署合作协议，共同推动国家863课题“中间相炭微球”项目产业化，从事负极材料的研发、生产和销售，在国内实现负极材料的商用推广。
column7: After the strategic direction was determined, Shanshan began to look for cooperation. At that time, <v>Anshan Institute of Thermal Energy's</v> carbon research institute supporting Ansteel was working on a national 863 project, and the research funds were insufficient. column6: 乘着通关复常的契机，旅游局铺开了香港市场的宣传攻势及推出各项优惠，其中包括推出了往返港澳交通票务优惠，以崭新的宣传片于线上线下平台投放广告等。
column7: Taking advantage of the <v>return</v> of customs clearance, MGTO launched a promotional campaign in the Hong Kong market and launched various discounts, including discounts on round-trip transportation tickets to Hong Kong and Macau, and advertising on online and offline platforms with brand-new promotional videos.

column7: Taking advantage of the return of customs clearance, MGTO <v>launched a promotional campaign in the Hong Kong market and launched</v> various discounts, including discounts on round-trip transportation tickets to Hong Kong and Macau, and advertising on online and offline platforms with brand-new promotional videos.

column6: 继上月邀请香港旅游业界领袖来澳交流考察及香港网红亲身体验澳门“旅游+”，这次再度组织香港旅游业界及传媒代表来澳考察，加大市场推广力度，吸引香港旅客来澳留宿消费，两地业界更洽商携手拓展港澳“联线同游”市场，共拓内地以至海外市场，促进两地旅游业复苏。
column7: After inviting Hong Kong tourism industry leaders to come to Macau for exchange and investigation last month and Hong Kong Internet celebrities to experience Macau's "<v>Travel</v> +" first-hand, this time organizes Hong Kong tourism industry and media representatives to visit Macau again to increase marketing efforts and attract Hong Kong tourists to stay in Macau In terms of consumption, the industries of the two places are even negotiating to join hands to expand the Hong Kong and Macau "connected travel" market, jointly expand the mainland and overseas markets, and promote the recovery of the tourism industry of the two places.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: 继上月邀请香港旅游业界领袖来澳交流考察及香港网红亲身体验澳门“旅游+”，这次再度组织香港旅游业界及传媒代表来澳考察，加大市场推广力度，吸引香港旅客来澳留宿消费，两地业界更洽商携手拓展港澳“联线同游”市场，共拓内地以至海外市场，促进两地旅游业复苏。
column7: After inviting Hong Kong tourism industry leaders to come to Macau for exchange and investigation last month and Hong Kong Internet celebrities to experience Macau's "<v>Travel</v> +" first-hand, this time organizes Hong Kong tourism industry and media representatives to visit Macau again to increase marketing efforts and attract Hong Kong tourists to stay in Macau. column7: The large-scale delegation of 100 people in Hong Kong included leaders of tourism-related departments of the Hong Kong Government, more than 60 representatives from travel agencies and cross-border transportation operators between Hong Kong and Macao, and about 30 reporters from travel magazines and newspapers, travel social media, online media representatives and bloggers/net celebrities, etc., to visit Macao for exchanges and visits to learn about Macao's latest tourism resources. column6: 乘着通关复常的契机，旅游局铺开了香港市场的宣传攻势及推出各项优惠，其中包括推出了往返港澳交通票务优惠，以崭新的宣传片于线上线下平台投放广告等。
column7: <v>Taking advantage of the opportunity for customs clearance to return to normal</v>, MGTO has launched a promotional campaign in the Hong Kong market and launched various discounts, including the launch of transportation ticketing discounts to and from Hong Kong and Macao, and the use of brand-new promotional videos to advertise on online and offline platforms.

column6: 继上月邀请香港旅游业界领袖来澳交流考察及香港网红亲身体验澳门“旅游+”，这次再度组织香港旅游业界及传媒代表来澳考察，加大市场推广力度，吸引香港旅客来澳留宿消费，两地业界更洽商携手拓展港澳“联线同游”市场，共拓内地以至海外市场，促进两地旅游业复苏。
column7: Following last month's invitation to leaders of the Hong Kong tourism industry to come to Macao for exchange and investigation and Hong Kong net celebrities to experience Macao's “Tourism+” firsthand, this time, representatives of the Hong Kong tourism industry and the media were once again organized to visit Macao to increase marketing efforts and attract Hong Kong tourists to stay in Macao for consumption. The two industries have also negotiated to work together to expand the “<v>online</v> travel” market in Hong Kong and Macao, jointly expand the Mainland and overseas markets, and promote the recovery of the tourism industry in the two places.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column6: 最近，美国对华“芯片战”大有升级之势——先是荷兰、日本两国在美国施压下，同意启动对华半导体制造设备出口的管制；后有外媒报道，美国政府正考虑切断美国供应商与华为公司之间的所有联系，禁止美国供应商向华为提供任何产品；拜登政府还准备公布一项行政命令，限制美国对敏感的中国科技行业的投资……2023年开年不久，美国在遏制中国半导体相关产业发展上就恶招不断。
column7: Recently, the "chip war" between the United States and China has greatly escalated. First, under pressure from the United States, the Netherlands and Japan agreed to start controlling the export of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China. Later, foreign media reported that the US government is considering cutting off all ties between US suppliers and Huawei and banning US suppliers from providing any products to Huawei. The Biden administration is also preparing to unveil an executive order restricting U.S. investment in sensitive Chinese technology industries... Soon after the beginning of 2023, the United States continued to use malicious tricks to curb the development of China's semiconductor-related industries.

column7: Attracting Hong Kong tourists and expanding "joint tours" between Hong Kong and Macao

column6: 乘着通关复常的契机，旅游局铺开了香港市场的宣传攻势及推出各项优惠，其中包括推出了往返港澳交通票务优惠，以崭新的宣传片于线上线下平台投放广告等。
column7: Taking advantage of the resumption of customs clearance, MGTO has launched promotional campaigns and concessions for the Hong Kong market, including the introduction of round-trip ticket concessions for transportation <v>to and from</v> Hong Kong and Macao, as well as new promotional videos and advertisements on online and offline platforms.

column6: 继上月邀请香港旅游业界领袖来澳交流考察及香港网红亲身体验澳门“旅游+”，这次再度组织香港旅游业界及传媒代表来澳考察，加大市场推广力度，吸引香港旅客来澳留宿消费，两地业界更洽商携手拓展港澳“联线同游”市场，共拓内地以至海外市场，促进两地旅游业复苏。
column7: Following the invitation of Hong Kong travel trade leaders to visit Macau last month and the experience of Hong Kong netizens in Macau's "Tourism +", this time, <v>we</v> organized another visit for Hong Kong's travel trade and media representatives, with a view to stepping up marketing efforts and attracting Hong Kong tourists to stay and spend money in Macau, as well as negotiating with the trade of the two places on the joint efforts in developing the market of "joint tours" between Hong Kong and Macau. column6: 据前美国中央情报局高级官员、现供职于华盛顿智库新美国安全中心的Martijn Rasser说。
column7: According to Martijn Rasser, a former senior CIA official who now works for the Center for a New American Security, a Washington think tank<v>.</v>

column6: “这无疑是火上浇油，支持了对华强硬派的观点”。
column7: “This is undoubtedly adding fuel to the fire and supporting the views of hardliners against China.”

column6: 白宫新闻秘书卡琳·让-皮埃尔(Karine Jean-Pierre)周四对记者表示，“我们还将考虑采取更大范围的行动，以揭露和应对中国更大规模的监视活动，这些活动对我们的国家安全以及我们的盟友和伙伴构成威胁。
column7: White House press secretary Karine Jean-Pierre told reporters on Thursday, “We will also consider taking broader actions to expose and respond to China's larger surveillance activities, which pose a threat to our national security and our allies and partners.

column6: ”美国官员说，他们已向30多个国家的政府通报了上述气球事件的情况，国际协调对于应对中国威胁至关重要。
column7: <v>"</v>U.S. officials said that they have notified the governments of more than 30 countries of the above-mentioned balloon incidents, and international coordination is essential to deal with the Chinese threat.

column6: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
column7: The export volume of the 11 main export categories all declined compared with the same period last year.

column6: 据台当局财政事务主管部门公布，台湾地区今年1月出口315.1亿美元，年减21.2%，连续第5个月负增长。
column7: According to the <v>financial affairs department</v> of the Taiwan authorities, Taiwan's exports in January this year were 31.51 billion US dollars, a year-on-year decrease of 21.2%, and a negative growth for the fifth consecutive month.

column6: 11项主要出口货类的出口额与去年同期相比，均出现衰退。
column7: The export volume of the 11 main export categories all declined compared to the same period last year.

column6: 塑橡胶及其制品、光学器材跌幅最深，分别年减37.6%、35.7%。
column7: Plastics, rubber and their products, and optical equipment had the deepest declines, with year-on-year decreases of 37.6% and 35.7% respectively.

column6: 电子零组件出口年减20.1%，创11年来最大减幅。
column7: Exports of electronic components decreased by 20.1% <v>year-on-year</v>, the largest decrease in 11 years.

column6: 其中，集成电路年减18.3%，创14年来最大跌势。
column7: Among them, integrated circuits decreased by 18.3% <v>year-on-year</v>, the largest decline in 14 years.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
column7: <v>Cai Meina</v>, the head of the department's statistics department, said that this shows that the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry is spreading, and the electronics industry is entering a correction period.

column6: 该部门统计处长蔡美娜表示，这显示消费性电子产业需求疲弱效应扩散，电子产业进入修正期。
column7: Cai Meina, the head of the <v>department's statistics department</v>, said that this shows that the weak demand effect of the consumer electronics industry is spreading, and the electronics industry is entering a correction period.

column6: 统计显示，1月台湾地区进出口双降，出超金额仅23.4亿美元，创近3年来最低水平。
column7: Statistics show that in January, Taiwan's imports and exports both fell, and the surplus was only 2.34 billion US dollars, the lowest level in <v>nearly</v> three years.‏‏‏‏‏‏‏‏

column7: Google's newly launched artificial intelligence chatbot, Bard, was at a disadvantage. It “<v>answered the wrong question</v>” in the promotional video, causing the stock price of Google's parent company Alphabet to plummet 8.9% on Wednesday, falling below the $100 mark, and the market capitalization evaporated by 110 billion US dollars (about RM476.5 billion). As of Friday's market closing report was 94.57 US dollars.

column7: Earthquake relief in Turkey and Syria day in and day out

column6: 土耳其与相接的叙利亚发生强震以来，来自几十个国家的救援队日以继夜地在数千座震毁建筑的废墟中辛勤工作，解救被埋在瓦砾下的幸存者。
column7: Since the earthquake struck Turkey and neighboring Syria, rescue teams from dozens of countries have worked hard day and night in the ruins of thousands of destroyed buildings to rescue survivors buried under the rubble.

column6: 在冰冷的温度下，他们经常呼吁保持安静，因为他们竭力想从破旧的混凝土堆中听到任何生命的声音。
column7: In the cold temperatures, they often call for silence as they struggle to hear any sound of life from their dilapidated concrete piles.

column6: 据路透社今天报道称，又有两名妇女在地震废墟中幸存数日后被救出。
column7: According to a Reuters report today, two more women were rescued after surviving in the ruins of the earthquake for a few days.

column6: 但是，地震造成的死亡人数攀升达24,150 人。
column7: However, the death toll from the earthquake climbed to 24,150.

column6: 土耳其死亡人数为20,665 人，叙利亚死亡人数超过3,500 人。

column6: 周一发生的7.8 级地震，在土耳其和叙利亚继续发生了几次强烈余震，是本世纪第七大致命自然灾害，超过了日本2011 年的地震和海啸，接近2003 年邻国伊朗地震造成的31,000 人死亡。
column7: The <v>7.8 magnitude</v> earthquake that occurred on Monday continued to have several strong aftershocks in Turkey and Syria. It was the seventh-deadliest natural disaster of this century, surpassing the 2011 earthquake and tsunami in Japan, and close to the death of 31,000 people caused by the 2003 earthquake in neighboring Iran.

column6: 1999 年在土耳其西北部发生的类似强烈地震造成17,000 多人丧生。

column6: 文莱大学是文莱最大的高等高等教育和科学研究中心，在本地区大学排行榜上位居第三。
column7: The University of Brunei is the largest higher education and scientific research <v>centre</v> in Brunei, ranking third in the region's university rankings.

column6: 文莱大学是越南与文莱在教育培训合作中的象征之一。
column7: The University of Brunei is one of the symbols of cooperation between Vietnam and Brunei in education and training.

column6: 文莱大学于2013年7月正式与越南FPT大学建立合作关系，主要合作领域是英语培训。
column7: The University of Brunei officially established a partnership with FPT University in Vietnam in July 2013, with the main area of cooperation being English training.

column6: 除了英语、法语、德育、日语和韩语等外语外，文莱大学还将越南语纳入教学课程。
column7: In addition to foreign languages such as English, French, <v>Moroccan</v>, Japanese and Korean, the University of Brunei also incorporates Vietnamese into its curriculum.

column6: 范明政总理为越来越多的外国人喜欢学习越南语而感到高兴，进而为把越南文化特色和风土人情形象推广到世界各地作出积极贡献。
column7: <v>Prime Minister Fan Mingong</v> is pleased that more and more foreigners like to learn the Vietnamese language, thus making a positive contribution to the promotion of Vietnamese culture and local identity to all over the world.

column6: 政府总理范明政表示相信并希望文莱大学的越南语教师队伍日益强大；越南语班的学员越来越对越南语感兴趣，努力学习，能够早日使用流利的越南语，并成为越文两国友好合作关系的使者。
column7: The Prime Minister expressed his belief and hope that the Vietnamese language teaching staff at the University of Brunei will grow stronger; the students of the Vietnamese language classes will become more and more interested in the Vietnamese language, work hard to learn, be able to use the Vietnamese language fluently at an early stage<v>,</v> and become ambassadors of the friendly and cooperative relations between the two countries.

column6: 趁此机会，范明政总理还通过视频方式与正在岘港市FPT-UBD全球中心学习英语的越南学生进行交流，了解他们特别是在疫情期间的学习情况。
column7: The Prime Minister also took the opportunity to communicate via video with Vietnamese students studying English at the FPT-UBD Global Centre in Da Nang to learn about their <v>learning, especially during the outbreak</v>.

column6: 最近，美国对华“芯片战”大有升级之势——先是荷兰、日本两国在美国施压下，同意启动对华半导体制造设备出口的管制；后有外媒报道，美国政府正考虑切断美国供应商与华为公司之间的所有联系，禁止美国供应商向华为提供任何产品；拜登政府还准备公布一项行政命令，限制美国对敏感的中国科技行业的投资……2023年开年不久，美国在遏制中国半导体相关产业发展上就恶招不断。
column7: Recently, the US has shown signs of escalating its <v>"</v>chip war" against China - first, under pressure from the US, the Netherlands and Japan agreed to initiate controls on the export of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China; then, foreign media reported that the US government is considering severing all ties between US suppliers and Huawei, prohibiting US suppliers from providing any products to Huawei; the Biden administration is also preparing to announce an executive order restricting US investment in sensitive Chinese tech industries... Shortly after the start of 2023, the US has been relentless in its efforts to curb the development of China's semiconductor-related industries.

column7: Recently, the US “chip war” against China has escalated — first, the Netherlands and Japan agreed to initiate controls on exports of semiconductor manufacturing equipment to China under pressure from the US; foreign media later reported that the US government was considering cutting off all ties between US suppliers and Huawei and prohibiting US suppliers from supplying any products to Huawei; the Biden administration is also preparing to issue an executive order restricting US investment in the sensitive Chinese technology industry... Shortly after the start of 2023, the US continued to make bad moves to curb the development of China's semiconductor-related industries.

column6: 近年来，美国打击中国“芯”发展的动作从未停歇，一边精准打压对华半导体产供链，一边构建“去中国化”的半导体产业链联盟，图谋在先进半导体产业上彻底“甩开”中国。
column7: In recent years, the US has never stopped cracking down on China's “<v>core</v>” development.
